qs.q: What problem does Ms. Delgado report?
o: A presenter has not arrived for the workshop.
Part of a food order is missing.
The caterer sent a bill to the wrong address.
A workshop has been moved to another day.
qs.h: 看 11:02 A.M. Bianca 的第一則訊息：送來的午餐少了什麼？
qs.trans: Delgado 女士回報了什麼問題？
qs.e: 11:02 A.M. Bianca 說「there are only vegetarian wraps. I'm sure we ordered a mix of chicken and vegetarian」，也就是訂的雞肉捲餅沒有送來，訂單少了一部分，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 文中未提到講者沒到，Bianca 反而打算請講者先進行問答時間；(C) 文中未提到帳單寄錯地址，只提到帳單打八折；(D) 工作坊照常進行，中午休息吃午餐，沒有改期。

qs.q: At 11:19 A.M., what does Ms. Delgado most likely mean when she writes, "I can live with that"?
o: She would prefer to receive a full refund.
She plans to pick up the food herself.
She considers the caterer's offer acceptable.
She will ask the caterer to send a fruit platter.
qs.h: 看前一則 11:18 A.M. Hector 轉述外燴公司提出了什麼補償，Bianca 接著的反應是接受還是拒絕？
qs.trans: 在上午 11:19，Delgado 女士寫道「I can live with that」，她最有可能是什麼意思？
qs.e: 11:18 A.M. Hector 說外燴公司提議「take 20 percent off the bill」並免費加送水果拼盤。Bianca 回「I can live with that」（這我可以接受），並接著安排問答時間等餐點送達，表示她接受這個補償方案，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 她並未要求全額退款，而是接受八折優惠；(B) 餐點將由司機在 12:15 前送來，不是她自己去拿；(D) 水果拼盤是外燴公司已主動提出的，不需要她再去要求。

qs.q: What is offered to people who join in March?
o: A waived registration charge
A free month of membership
A discount on fitness equipment
A complimentary gym bag
qs.h: 看廣告第一句，3 月 1 日至 31 日加入可以免付什麼費用？
qs.trans: 3 月加入的人可以獲得什麼優惠？
qs.e: 第一句說「Join ... between March 1 and March 31 and pay no enrollment fee」，免收入會費，即 waived registration charge（免除登記費用），故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 優惠是免入會費及兩堂免費教練課，不是免費一個月；(C) 文中未提到健身器材折扣；(D) 文中未提到贈送健身包。

qs.q: What is indicated about the Premier membership?
o: It is available only to students.
It does not include group classes.
It is the least expensive option.
It provides access to a swimming pool.
qs.h: 看 Premier 方案那一行，除了 Plus 的內容之外還多了哪些設施？
qs.trans: 關於尊爵（Premier）方案，文中提到了什麼？
qs.e: Premier 方案寫著「Everything in Plus, plus 24-hour access and use of the indoor pool and sauna」，可使用室內游泳池，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 學生只是享有九折優惠，並非此方案僅限學生；(B) Premier 包含 Plus 的所有內容，而 Plus 包含無限次團體課程；(C) 每月 72 美元是三個方案中最貴的。

qs.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
o: To announce the opening of a new library branch
To request volunteers for a renovation project
To inform people about a temporary closure
To explain changes to the center's opening hours
qs.h: 主旨題看第一段第一句：哪些空間要關閉、關閉多久？
qs.trans: 這則公告的目的是什麼？
qs.e: 第一句指出二樓會議室「will be closed for approximately three weeks while new flooring and lighting are installed」，整篇公告在說明暫時關閉及後續安排，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) Fairlawn 分館只是提供的替代場地，並非新開幕；(B) 文中沒有招募志工；(D) 其他設施「remain open during their regular hours」，開放時間並未改變。

qs.q: What will some groups with reservations be offered?
o: The use of another facility
A discount on future bookings
Free use of the gymnasium
Priority access to the computer lab
qs.h: 看第二段：已預約二樓會議室的團體會被提供什麼？
qs.trans: 部分已預約的團體將獲得什麼？
qs.e: 第二段說已預約的團體將「offered space at the Fairlawn Branch Library」，也就是改用另一處場地，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 不想換場地的團體可取消並全額退款，並非未來預約折扣；(C) 體育館只是照常開放，沒有說免費提供；(D) 文中未提到電腦教室優先使用權。

qs.q: Why did Ganton Architects receive a credit?
o: One of its deliveries arrived late.
It paid a previous invoice early.
It shipped an oversize item.
It used the service a certain number of times in a month.
qs.h: 找 Monthly account credit 那一行括號內的條件。
qs.trans: Ganton 建築師事務所為什麼獲得折抵？
qs.e: 折抵說明為「5% for clients with 4 or more deliveries in a month」，該公司 9 月共寄送 4 件，達到單月寄送次數的門檻，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 發票上沒有提到延遲送達；(B) 沒有提到提早付款；(C) 9 月 25 日確實寄了超大型文件筒，但折抵與此無關，而是取決於寄送件數。

qs.q: What is suggested about Ganton Architects?
o: It will pay more for standard deliveries starting in November.
It sent items to the same destination more than once.
It has already paid this invoice online.
Its office is located at a construction site.
qs.h: 比對表格中 Destination 一欄，有沒有重複出現的地點？
qs.trans: 關於 Ganton 建築師事務所，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 表格中 9 月 4 日與 9 月 18 日的送達地點都是「Hale County Courthouse」，可知該公司不只一次寄送到同一地點，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 11 月起漲價的是急件（rush deliveries），不是標準件；(C) 這是剛開立的發票，付款期限為 30 天內，看不出已付款；(D) 工地辦公室（Delford Construction site office）是收件地點之一，不是該公司的地址。

qs.q: What are the writers mainly discussing?
o: Renewing a software subscription
Training new employees on a program
Hiring members for a design team
Moving files to a new office
qs.h: 看 2:03 P.M. Ayesha 開啟的話題，以及之後大家討論的重點。
qs.trans: 這些人主要在討論什麼？
qs.e: Ayesha 一開始就提到「Our Clearboard subscription renews on May 1」與漲價，之後大家討論是否改用年繳方案或換工具，主要話題是軟體訂閱的續約，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 沒有討論訓練新進員工；(C) 設計團隊只是被提到很依賴時間軸功能，並非要招募成員；(D) Gordon 提到的是過去把專案檔案移進 Clearboard，與搬到新辦公室無關。

qs.q: At 2:11 P.M., what does Ms. Draper most likely mean when she writes, "Fair point"?
o: She thinks the new price is reasonable.
She wants to cancel her team's accounts.
She agrees that switching to another tool may not be practical.
She will start using the timeline feature.
qs.h: 看 2:08 P.M. Elsa 的提議和 2:10 P.M. Gordon 反對的理由，她的回應是針對誰的論點？
qs.trans: 在下午 2:11，Draper 女士寫道「Fair point」，她最有可能是什麼意思？
qs.e: Elsa 原本提議看看其他工具，Gordon 反對並說明移轉檔案花了兩個月，且設計團隊每天依賴時間軸功能。Elsa 回「Fair point」（說得有道理），表示她認同換工具不切實際，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 她回應的是 Gordon 不換工具的理由，不是在評論價格；(B) 她並沒有要取消帳號，只會去確認需要的人數；(D) 依賴時間軸功能的是設計團隊，不是她要開始使用。

qs.q: What will Ms. Bhatt most likely do next?
o: Cancel the Clearboard subscription
Train the design team
Compare other project tools
Request approval for a yearly payment plan
qs.h: 看 2:13 P.M. Ayesha 說「Then I'll ...」接下來要做什麼。
qs.trans: Bhatt 女士接下來最有可能做什麼？
qs.e: 2:13 P.M. Ayesha 說「Then I'll ask the finance department to approve the annual plan」，她要請財務部核准年繳方案，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 他們決定續用 Clearboard，並未取消；(B) 文中沒有提到訓練設計團隊；(C) 比較其他工具是 Elsa 的提議，已被 Gordon 說服而放棄。

qs.q: What is included in a professional headshot session?
o: A printed portrait
More than one change of clothing
A one-hour photo shoot
Delivery of images within 24 hours
qs.h: 看 Professional Headshots 段落中「Each 30-minute session includes ...」的內容。
qs.trans: 專業形象照的拍攝包含什麼？
qs.e: 形象照段落寫著「Each 30-minute session includes two outfit changes and three retouched digital images」，包含兩次換裝，即不只一次更換服裝，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 提供的是三張修圖後的「數位」照片，未提到印刷相片；(C) 每次拍攝 30 分鐘，不是一小時；(D) 形象照的交件時間未提及，24 小時是改期收費的期限。

qs.q: What is indicated about Corporate Team Packages?
o: Photo sessions take place at the client's workplace.
They require at least 15 participants.
Images are delivered on the same day.
They include product photography.
qs.h: 看 Corporate Team Packages 段落：「We come to you!」以及攝影師會在哪裡架設攝影棚。
qs.trans: 關於企業團體方案，文中提到了什麼？
qs.e: 企業方案寫著「We come to you! ... our photographers will set up a portable studio at your workplace」，攝影會在客戶的工作場所進行，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 門檻是 10 人以上，15 是商品攝影可送件的數量上限；(C) 照片於五個工作天內交付，不是當天；(D) 商品攝影是另一項獨立服務，須將商品送到工作室。

qs.q: What is NOT mentioned on the Web page?
o: Gift certificates can be purchased.
A fee is charged for late rescheduling.
Customers who refer friends receive a discount.
Products are returned to their owners.
qs.h: NOT 題：把四個選項逐一回原文核對，特別看 Booking 與 Product Photography 兩段。
qs.trans: 網頁上「沒有」提到下列哪一項？
qs.e: 網頁提到禮券、24 小時內改期收費 30 美元，以及商品攝影後歸還商品，但完全沒有提到介紹朋友可享折扣，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) Booking 段最後一句「Gift certificates are available in any amount」；(B) 「reschedule with less than 24 hours' notice will be charged a $30 fee」；(D) 商品攝影段「We return the products along with edited images」。

qs.q: What is one responsibility of the office coordinator?
o: Designing school buildings
Photographing construction sites
Hiring new staff members
Arranging gatherings for employees
qs.h: 看第二段列出的職責（Responsibilities include ...）。
qs.trans: 辦公室協調專員的職責之一是什麼？
qs.e: 第二段職責包括「organizing the firm's quarterly staff events」，籌辦每季員工活動即「安排員工聚會」，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 設計學校是事務所的專業，不是協調專員的工作；(B) 協調專員是「蒐集已完工建築的照片」，不是去工地拍照；(C) 文中未提到招募員工。

qs.q: What is a requirement for the position?
o: A degree in architecture
Previous experience in office administration
Knowledge of design software
A valid driver's license
qs.h: 看第三段「Applicants should have ...」，注意哪一項是 helpful but not required。
qs.trans: 這個職位的必要條件是什麼？
qs.e: 第三段說「Applicants should have at least two years of administrative experience」，須具備行政工作經驗，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 文中未要求建築學位；(C) 熟悉設計軟體「is helpful but not required」，不是必要條件；(D) 文中未提到駕照，只提到交通津貼。

qs.q: What is suggested about Fenwick & Abara Architects?
o: It designs buildings used for education.
It is opening a second office.
It plans to hire several coordinators.
It has recently increased its number of employees.
qs.h: 看第一句對這家事務所的介紹：它專精於設計哪一類建築？
qs.trans: 關於 Fenwick & Abara 建築師事務所，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第一句說該事務所「specializing in school and library design」，專門設計學校等建築，可知它設計教育用途的建築，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 文中未提到開設第二間辦公室；(C) 只招募「a full-time office coordinator」一名；(D) 只說是 40 人的事務所，沒有提到最近增加員工。

qs.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
o: To ask employees to recommend a moving company
To ask employees to vote on a new office location
To provide instructions for an upcoming office move
To announce changes to the IT department's policies
qs.h: 主旨題：整篇備忘錄的各段分別交代了搬遷的哪些事項？
qs.trans: 這份備忘錄的目的是什麼？
qs.e: 備忘錄依序說明搬遷日期、打包與標示紙箱的方式、8 月 24 日在家工作、停車位申請等，主要是在提供辦公室搬遷的相關指示，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 搬家公司 Bexley 已經確定，沒有請員工推薦；(B) 新地點上個月已宣布（As announced last month），不需投票；(D) IT 團隊只負責搬運與架設設備，沒有提到政策變更。

qs.q: What is stated about the Ardmore Tower?
o: It has more parking spaces than the Delancey Building.
It has only twelve floors.
It will be closed on August 25.
It is near a train station.
qs.h: 看第一段描述新辦公空間位置的句子。
qs.trans: 關於 Ardmore 大樓，文中提到了什麼？
qs.e: 第一段說新辦公室「is located directly across from the Eastgate train station」，就在火車站正對面，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 文中只說 Ardmore 大樓停車位有限，並未與 Delancey 大樓比較；(B) 只說公司搬到 12 樓，沒有說大樓只有 12 層；(C) 8 月 25 日是新辦公室啟用的日子，關閉的是 8 月 24 日。

qs.q: What is suggested about parking at the Ardmore Tower?
o: Employees who apply early are more likely to get a space.
It is provided free of charge to all employees.
It is managed by Bexley Relocation Services.
Requests should be sent to the IT team.
qs.h: 看第四段：車位有限，而且分配的原則是什麼？
qs.trans: 關於 Ardmore 大樓的停車，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第四段說車位有限（Parking ... is limited），且「Spaces will be assigned on a first-come, first-served basis」，先到先得，因此越早申請越有機會取得車位，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 員工須「rent a space」，是租用而非免費；(C) Bexley 是搬家公司，與停車場無關；(D) 申請須交給寫備忘錄的 Frances Galloway（submit a request to me），不是 IT 團隊。

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Boxes without this information may be delivered to the wrong area of the new office."
qs.h: 待插入句的「this information」指的是什麼資訊？找出前一句剛說明要在紙箱上寫什麼的位置。
qs.trans:
下列句子最適合填入標示 [1]、[2]、[3]、[4] 的哪一個位置？
「沒有標示這些資訊的紙箱可能會被送到新辦公室的錯誤區域。」
qs.e: [2] 的前一句要求「Label every box with your name and your new desk number」，待插入句的「Boxes without this information」正好指沒有標上姓名與新座位編號的紙箱，語意緊密銜接，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) [1] 前一句在談通勤時間縮短，尚未提到紙箱；(C) [3] 前一句在談在家工作並查看電子郵件，與紙箱標示無關；(D) [4] 前一句在談停車位分配，this information 無從對應。

qs.q: Why did Ms. Ferraro write the letter?
o: To thank Mr. Esposito for opening a new account
To request updated personal information
To inform a customer about changes to services
To announce the opening of a new branch
qs.h: 看第一段第二句「We are writing to let you know about ...」。
qs.trans: Ferraro 女士為什麼寫這封信？
qs.e: 第一段說「We are writing to let you know about upcoming changes to your Everyday Checking account」，後文說明月費調整與新的行動存款功能，目的是通知客戶服務變更，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 開頭雖感謝他是重要客戶，但沒有提到他新開帳戶；(B) 信中未要求更新個人資料；(D) 信中只請他前往「any of our branches」，沒有宣布新分行開幕。

qs.q: What is suggested about Mr. Esposito?
o: He visits a bank branch every week.
He will probably not have to pay the higher fee.
He recently opened a second account.
He keeps at least $1,500 in his account.
qs.h: 看第二段：免收月費的條件是什麼？銀行紀錄顯示他的帳戶有什麼情況？
qs.trans: 關於 Esposito 先生，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第二段說有直接入帳的月份可免月費，而「your account receives direct deposits every month, so this change is unlikely to affect you」，可推知他大概不必支付調漲後的費用，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 信中未提到他多久去一次分行；(C) 信中未提到第二個帳戶；(D) 他符合免費條件是因為每月有直接入帳，信中並未說明他的餘額是否達 1,500 美元。

qs.q: In the letter, the word "reflected" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
o: considered
copied
returned
shown
qs.h: 看第二段最後一句：費用會「reflected」在每月對帳單上，指的是費用會怎樣出現在對帳單上？
qs.trans: 在信中，第二段的「reflected」一詞意思最接近下列何者？
qs.e: 第二段最後一句「Any fee that does apply will be reflected on your monthly statement」指費用會「顯示、列出」在每月對帳單上，reflect 在此作「呈現、顯示」解，與 shown 最接近，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) considered 是 reflect 作「思考」時的意思（reflect on），不符本句；(B) copied 是「模仿、複製」，不符；(C) returned 是 reflect 作「反射（光線）」的引申，不符對帳單的語境。

qs.q: According to the letter, what will customers be able to do starting on November 15?
o: Deposit checks by using a mobile phone
Speak to a representative on Sundays
Open an account online
Withdraw cash at any bank without a fee
qs.h: 看第三段，找 November 15 這個日期。
qs.trans: 根據信件，客戶從 11 月 15 日起可以做什麼？
qs.e: 第三段說客戶將能「deposit checks by taking a photo with the Hartwell mobile app」，且「This feature will be available beginning November 15」，即可用手機存入支票，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 客服時間是「Monday through Saturday」，星期日沒有服務；(C) 信中未提到線上開戶；(D) 信中未提到免手續費提款。

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
o: The opening of a new home-improvement store
A change in ticket prices for an annual event
The relocation of a yearly event
The construction of a convention center
qs.h: 看標題與第一段第一句：博覽會今年有什麼改變？
qs.trans: 這篇文章主要是關於什麼？
qs.e: 標題「Home and Garden Expo Moves to Larger Venue」與第一句都指出已舉辦十一年的博覽會「will move to the newly built Hollins Convention Center」，文章主旨是年度活動更換場地，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 文中沒有提到新開的居家修繕商店；(B) 最後一段只說明網路預購較便宜，並未提到票價調整；(D) 會議中心只是被提到「newly built」，文章重點是博覽會搬遷而非建造過程。

qs.q: What is NOT stated about the Great Prairie Home and Garden Expo?
o: It has been held in the same place for more than ten years.
It could not accept all the companies that applied last year.
It will offer free educational sessions.
It will include exhibitors from other countries.
qs.h: NOT 題：逐一核對第一段（舉辦年數、申請家數）與第三段（新增活動）。
qs.trans: 關於大草原居家與園藝博覽會，文中「沒有」提到下列哪一項？
qs.e: 文中提到在同一場館舉辦了十一年、去年 300 多家申請只能容納 210 家、將新增免費工作坊，但完全沒有提到外國參展商，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 第一段「held at the Dalbury Exhibition Hall for the past eleven years」；(B) 第一段「more than 300 companies applied ... only 210 could be accommodated」；(C) 第三段「add a series of free workshops」。

qs.q: In the article, the word "run" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to
o: flow
take place
hurry
manage
qs.h: 看第四段第一句：博覽會「run from April 17 to 19」，run 後面接的是一段日期。
qs.trans: 在文章中，第四段的「run」一詞意思最接近下列何者？
qs.e: 第四段「The expo will run from April 17 to 19」中，run 搭配一段期間，表示活動「進行、舉行」，與 take place 最接近，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) flow 是「（液體）流動」，如 water runs；(C) hurry 是 run 作「跑、趕」的意思；(D) manage 是 run 作「經營（公司）」的意思，皆不符本句。

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Each of these sessions will be led by a local contractor or designer."
qs.h: 待插入句的「these sessions」指的是前文提到的什麼活動？找出剛介紹完某種課程或場次的位置。
qs.trans:
下列句子最適合填入標示 [1]、[2]、[3]、[4] 的哪一個位置？
「每一場課程都將由當地的承包商或設計師主講。」
qs.e: [3] 的前一句提到博覽會將新增「a series of free workshops on topics such as energy-efficient windows and kitchen remodeling」，待插入句的「these sessions」正好指這些工作坊，並補充由誰主講，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) [1] 前一句在談去年申請攤位的家數，沒有任何課程；(B) [2] 前一句在談戶外中庭的園藝展示，展示不是 sessions；(D) [4] 前一句在談參展商預訂攤位的期限，與課程講者無關。

qs.q: What is stated about flight 418?
o: It will not operate on June 14.
It has been moved to a different airport.
It will depart later than scheduled.
It has been changed to a nonstop flight.
qs.h: 看第一篇第一段：418 號班機發生了什麼事？
qs.trans: 關於 418 號班機，文中提到了什麼？
qs.e: 第一篇第一段說「flight 418 from Denver to Halifax on June 14 has been canceled」，班機已取消，即 6 月 14 日不會飛，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 文中沒有提到更換機場；(C) 班機是取消，不是延後起飛；(D) 「Nonstop」是第二篇部分替代航班的資訊，與 418 號班機無關。

qs.q: According to the e-mail, what can Mr. Fairley do on the airline's Web site?
o: Print a boarding pass
Book a hotel room
Upgrade his seat
Ask for his money back
qs.h: 看第一篇第三段「visit "Manage My Trip" on our Web site」前面說可以做哪兩件事。
qs.trans: 根據電子郵件，Fairley 先生可以在航空公司網站上做什麼？
qs.e: 第一篇第三段說「To select a new flight or request a refund, visit "Manage My Trip" on our Web site」，可以在網站上申請退款，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 文中未提到列印登機證；(B) 住宿券是搭乘午夜後抵達航班的旅客會獲得的，沒有說可在網站訂房；(C) 第二篇只說改搭替代航班者維持原艙等，沒有提到升等。

qs.q: Which flight would provide Mr. Fairley with a free hotel stay?
o: BC 422
BC 436
BC 430
BC 440
qs.h: 第一篇說在什麼時間之後抵達的航班會附免費住宿券？再到第二篇的 Arrives 欄找出符合的航班。
qs.trans: 哪一個航班會讓 Fairley 先生獲得免費住宿？
qs.e: 第一篇說「passengers on any flight arriving in Halifax after midnight will receive a complimentary hotel voucher」；第二篇中只有 BC 436 於「1:05 A.M. (June 15)」抵達，是午夜過後，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) BC 422 下午 3:55 抵達；(C) BC 430 晚上 11:20 抵達，仍在午夜之前；(D) BC 440 下午 4:35 抵達，都不符合午夜後抵達的條件。

qs.q: If Mr. Fairley does not contact the airline by June 7, which flight will he most likely be placed on?
o: BC 430
BC 440
BC 422
BC 436
qs.h: 第一篇最後一段說，若未在期限內回覆，會被自動安排到哪一種航班？再看第二篇哪一班最早出發。
qs.trans: 如果 Fairley 先生在 6 月 7 日前沒有聯絡航空公司，他最有可能被安排搭乘哪一個航班？
qs.e: 第一篇說若 6 月 7 日前未回覆「you will automatically be placed on the earliest available alternative flight」；第二篇中最早的是 6 月 14 日上午 6:10 起飛的 BC 422，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) BC 430 下午 1:45 才起飛；(B) BC 440 是 6 月 15 日的航班；(D) BC 436 下午 4:30 起飛，都比 BC 422 晚。

qs.q: What is suggested about flight BC 440?
o: It departs on a different day from Mr. Fairley's original flight.
It makes a stop in Chicago.
It arrives in Halifax after midnight.
It is the earliest of the alternative flights.
qs.h: 比對第二篇 BC 440 的日期，與第一篇原本 418 號班機的日期。
qs.trans: 關於 BC 440 航班，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第一篇指出原本的 418 號班機是 6 月 14 日，而第二篇 BC 440 的日期是 June 15，可知它與原航班不同天出發，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) BC 440 是 Nonstop 直飛，在芝加哥轉機的是 BC 422；(C) BC 440 下午 4:35 抵達，不是午夜後；(D) 最早的替代航班是 6 月 14 日上午 6:10 的 BC 422。

qs.q: Why did Ms. Huang go to Ember & Ash Bistro?
o: To meet with a new client
To interview a job candidate
To celebrate a birthday
To mark the end of a work assignment
qs.h: 看第一篇第一句，她帶同事去用餐的原因是什麼？
qs.trans: Huang 女士為什麼去 Ember & Ash 小酒館？
qs.e: 第一篇第一句說她帶同事去「to celebrate the completion of a big project」，慶祝大型專案完成，即慶祝一項工作告一段落，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 同行的是四位同事，不是新客戶；(B) 文中未提到面試；(C) 文中未提到慶生。

qs.q: What does Ms. Huang NOT mention in her review?
o: The quality of a main dish
The price of the meal
The noise level in the dining room
A delay in being seated
qs.h: NOT 題：把四個選項逐一回第一篇核對。
qs.trans: Huang 女士在評論中「沒有」提到下列哪一項？
qs.e: 評論提到烤鴨的美味、用餐區太吵、等了 40 分鐘才入座，但完全沒有提到餐點價格，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 「The roasted duck was the best I have ever had」；(C) 「the dining room was so loud that we could barely hear each other」；(D) 「we were not seated until 7:40」。

qs.q: To whom has Mr. Bautista most likely passed on Ms. Huang's compliments?
o: Felipe
The host
The head chef
Ms. Huang's colleagues
qs.h: 第二篇第二段說讚美轉達給了哪個職位的人？再回第一篇找那個人的名字。
qs.trans: Bautista 先生最有可能把 Huang 女士的讚美轉達給誰？
qs.e: 第二篇第二段說「I have passed your kind words on to our server」，而第一篇提到「Our server, Felipe, was attentive」，可知轉達的對象是服務生 Felipe，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 帶位人員是她抱怨沒有說明的對象，不是讚美對象；(C) 她雖稱讚烤鴨，但信中明確說轉達給服務生，而非主廚；(D) 同事是和她一起用餐的人，不是轉達對象。

qs.q: Which concern mentioned in the review will be addressed next month?
o: The long wait for a table
The host's lack of explanation
The difficulty of hearing conversations
The limited seating on the patio
qs.h: 第二篇提到下個月要安裝什麼？它是用來解決第一篇的哪一項抱怨？
qs.trans: 評論中提到的哪一項問題將在下個月獲得改善？
qs.e: 第二篇說「we will be installing sound-absorbing panels on the dining room ceiling next month」，吸音板針對的是第一篇抱怨的「so loud that we could barely hear each other」，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 等位問題的訂位系統「have since changed」，已經改善，不是下個月；(B) 信中未回應帶位人員未說明一事；(D) 她只說下次想坐露台，並未抱怨露台座位不足。

qs.q: What does Mr. Bautista offer Ms. Huang?
o: A discount on her next bill
A reserved table on the patio
A tour of the kitchen
Free desserts for everyone in her group
qs.h: 看第二篇最後一段「As a thank-you, ...」。
qs.trans: Bautista 先生提供 Huang 女士什麼？
qs.e: 第二篇最後一段說「I would like to offer a complimentary dessert to each member of your party on your next visit」，下次光臨時同行每人一份免費甜點，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 提供的是免費甜點，不是帳單折扣；(B) 露台座位是她自己在評論中說下次想要求的，老闆並未提供；(C) 信中未提到參觀廚房。

qs.q: What is indicated about Fallbrook Lodge?
o: It has recently been renovated.
It is located beside a lake.
It accepts groups of any size.
It offers free airport transportation.
qs.h: 看第一篇第一句對山莊位置的描述。
qs.trans: 關於 Fallbrook 山莊，文中提到了什麼？
qs.e: 第一篇第一句說「Fallbrook Lodge, located on the shore of Lake Edenvale」，山莊位於湖畔，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 文中未提到翻修；(C) 團體方案只適用於「groups of 15 or more guests」；(D) 文中未提到機場接駁。

qs.q: What is the standard nightly rate per person for the package Ms. Chowdhury chose on the form?
qs.h: 先看第二篇 Package of interest 欄填了哪個方案，再到第一篇找該方案的價格。
qs.trans: Chowdhury 女士在表格上所選方案的每人每晚標準價格是多少？
qs.e: 第二篇的「Package of interest: Summit」，對照第一篇「Summit Package — $210 per person per night」，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 165 美元是湖畔方案的價格；(C) 260 美元是尊榮方案的價格；(D) 400 美元是第三篇提到加租第二間會議室的每日費用。

qs.q: According to the form, what does Ms. Chowdhury request?
o: Rooms on the same floor
A late check-out time
Transportation from the airport
Meat-free meal options
qs.h: 看第二篇 Additional requests 的內容。
qs.trans: 根據表格，Chowdhury 女士提出了什麼要求？
qs.e: 第二篇的其他需求寫著「We would also like a vegetarian option at every meal」，希望每餐都有素食，即不含肉類的餐點選擇，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 她沒有要求同一樓層的客房；(B) 她沒有要求延後退房；(C) 她沒有要求機場接送。

qs.q: What is NOT included in the package Ms. Chowdhury chose on the form?
o: A room overlooking the lake
A morning meal
An evening meal
Audiovisual equipment
qs.h: 她在第二篇選的是哪個方案？到第一篇看該方案包含哪些項目。
qs.trans: Chowdhury 女士在表格上所選的方案「不」包含下列哪一項？
qs.e: 第二篇她選的是 Summit 方案，第一篇列出其內容為「Lake-view room, breakfast and lunch, one meeting room, and audiovisual equipment」，只含早餐與午餐，不含晚餐，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 方案包含「Lake-view room」湖景客房；(B) 方案包含「breakfast」早餐；(D) 方案包含「audiovisual equipment」視聽設備。

qs.q: In the e-mail, the word "hold" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
o: host
secure
grasp
contain
qs.h: 看第三篇第三段最後一句：支付訂金是為了對訂位做什麼？
qs.trans: 在電子郵件中，第三段的「hold」一詞意思最接近下列何者？
qs.e: 第三篇第三段「a deposit of 25 percent is required to hold the reservation」指支付訂金才能「保留、確保」訂位，hold 在此與 secure 最接近，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) host 是 hold 作「舉辦」的意思，如第二篇的 hold workshops，但不符本句；(C) grasp 是「用手抓住」；(D) contain 是「容納」，皆不符保留訂位的語意。

qs.q: According to the Web page, how can customers reduce the base rate?
o: By renting a vehicle for at least a week
By returning a vehicle early
By making a reservation online
By adding a second driver
qs.h: 看第一篇最後一段關於「percent off the base rate」的條件。
qs.trans: 根據網頁，顧客可以如何降低基本費率？
qs.e: 第一篇說「Rentals of seven days or longer receive 15 percent off the base rate」，租期七天以上可享折扣，即至少租一週，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 網頁只提到晚還車會加收費用，未提到提早還車有優惠；(C) 網頁未提到線上預訂優惠；(D) 增加駕駛人須每日加付 12 美元，反而增加費用。

qs.q: What is indicated about the vehicle Mr. Faulk reserved?
o: It is the company's least expensive vehicle.
It came with a GPS unit.
It has seating for seven people.
It was rented for one week.
qs.h: 看第二篇 Vehicle class 欄的車型，再到第一篇查該車型的座位數。
qs.trans: 關於 Faulk 先生預訂的車輛，文中提到了什麼？
qs.e: 第二篇顯示他訂的是「Full-size SUV」，對照第一篇「Full-size SUV (seats 7)」，可知該車有七個座位，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 最便宜的是每日 42 美元的經濟型，休旅車為每日 89 美元；(B) 第三篇說取車時「there was no GPS device in the vehicle」；(D) 第二篇顯示租期為 5 月 3 日至 6 日共 3 天。

qs.q: What is suggested about the $89 extra-day charge?
o: It is equal to the daily rate for a midsize car.
It was added because the vehicle was returned dirty.
It has already been refunded to Mr. Faulk.
It does not follow the company's policy on late returns.
qs.h: 比對第二篇預定的還車時間、第三篇實際還車時間，以及第一篇對逾時還車的規定。
qs.trans: 關於那筆 89 美元的加收一天費用，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第二篇預定還車時間為上午 10:00，第三篇說他「returned the vehicle at 10:45 A.M.」，只晚了 45 分鐘；而第一篇規定「more than one hour after the scheduled return time」才會加收一天，因此這筆費用不符合公司的逾時還車規定，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 中型車每日 55 美元，89 美元是全尺寸休旅車的日租金；(B) 第三篇說「the SUV was very clean」；(C) 他才剛寫信要求更正，文中沒有提到已退款。

qs.q: What is one problem Mr. Faulk reports in his e-mail?
o: The vehicle had not been cleaned.
He was billed for equipment he did not use.
His return flight was canceled.
The car was not ready when he arrived.
qs.h: 看第三篇第二段他提到的另一項費用問題。
qs.trans: Faulk 先生在電子郵件中回報的問題之一是什麼？
qs.e: 第三篇第二段說「I was also charged for a GPS unit, even though I never requested one」，被收取了沒用到的導航設備費用，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 他說車子「very clean」；(C) 他遲還車是因為高速公路塞車，沒有提到航班取消；(D) 他沒有抱怨取車時車輛未備妥。

qs.q: What is suggested about Mr. Faulk?
o: He planned to share the driving with another person.
He has rented vehicles from Gearline many times.
He picked up the vehicle in the afternoon.
He asked for a navigation device when he reserved the car.
qs.h: 看第二篇 Extras 欄加購了什麼，以及登記的是誰的名字。
qs.trans: 關於 Faulk 先生，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第二篇的加購項目為「Additional driver (Celia Faulk)」，他另外登記了一位駕駛人，可推知他打算與另一人輪流開車，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 文中看不出他過去租車的次數；(C) 第二篇顯示取車時間是上午 10:00；(D) 第二篇加購項目只有增加駕駛人，第三篇也說「I never requested one」。

qs.q: According to the information, what is required when requesting service?
o: A photo of the damaged appliance
A phone call to a local store
Online registration of the product
Proof of purchase
qs.h: 看第一篇最後一段申請維修的說明。
qs.trans: 根據說明資訊，申請維修時需要什麼？
qs.e: 第一篇最後一段說「A copy of the original receipt is required」，須附原始收據影本，即購買證明，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 未要求附上損壞家電的照片；(B) 申請方式是線上填表，不是打電話給門市；(C) 只需線上填寫維修申請表，未提到產品線上註冊。

qs.q: What is NOT mentioned in the information?
o: How long dishwashers are covered
Damage resulting from incorrect installation
Free delivery of replacement appliances
A time limit for buying extended coverage
qs.h: NOT 題：把四個選項逐一回第一篇核對。
qs.trans: 說明資訊中「沒有」提到下列哪一項？
qs.e: 第一篇提到洗碗機保固期、安裝不當不在保固範圍、購買 CarePlus 的 90 天期限，但沒有提到免費運送替換家電，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 「Dishwashers: 1 year parts and labor」；(B) 「does not cover damage caused by improper installation」；(D) 「purchasing a Hearthstone CarePlus plan within 90 days of the purchase date」。

qs.q: Why will Mr. Garza receive the replacement part at no cost?
o: He purchased a CarePlus plan.
The part is covered for three years.
The technician caused the problem.
The machine is less than one year old.
qs.h: 第三篇說要更換哪個零件？到第一篇查洗衣機這個零件的保固年限，再對照第二篇的購買日期。
qs.trans: Garza 先生為什麼能免費獲得更換的零件？
qs.e: 第三篇說需更換的是馬達，且馬達免費；第一篇規定洗衣機「3 years on the motor (parts only)」，第二篇購買日期為 2025 年 5 月 22 日，至申請日 2026 年 10 月 12 日未滿三年，因此馬達仍在保固內，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 第二篇「CarePlus plan: No」；(C) 文中沒有說是技師造成的問題；(D) 第二篇顯示洗衣機購買至今已超過一年。

qs.q: Why will Mr. Garza most likely have to pay $95?
o: His machine was purchased more than one year before his request.
He did not attach a copy of his receipt.
His machine was damaged by a power surge.
He asked for an appointment on a weekend.
qs.h: 95 美元是技師到府與安裝的費用（工資）。第一篇洗衣機的工資保固是幾年？第二篇的購買日期與申請日期相差多久？
qs.trans: Garza 先生最有可能為什麼要付 95 美元？
qs.e: 第三篇說 95 美元是「the technician's visit and installation」的費用；第一篇洗衣機的工資只保固「1 year parts and labor」，而第二篇顯示他於 2025 年 5 月 22 日購買、2026 年 10 月 12 日才申請，已超過一年，所以工資須自付，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 第二篇「Copy of receipt attached: Yes」；(C) 文中沒有提到電力突波；(D) 他還沒預約，技師提供的是 10 月 20 日的時段，信中請他確認或另提平日時間。

qs.q: What is Mr. Garza asked to do?
o: Send a copy of his receipt
Pay the service fee in advance
Purchase a CarePlus plan
Confirm whether a visit time is suitable
qs.h: 看第三篇第二段最後的請求「Please reply to this e-mail to ...」。
qs.trans: Garza 先生被要求做什麼？
qs.e: 第三篇第二段說「Please reply to this e-mail to confirm that this time is convenient, or suggest another weekday」，請他確認到府時段是否方便，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 第二篇顯示他已附上收據影本；(B) 信中只說會收費，沒有要求預先付款；(C) 信中沒有建議他購買 CarePlus，而且購買期限是購買日起 90 天內，早已過期。

passages.kind: 手機簡訊討論串 Text Message Chain
passages.text:
Isaac Pereira (7:42 A.M.):
Marisol, the truck from Ottoline Foods just pulled into the yard, but Dock 4 is still blocked. The overnight crew left two pallets of returned goods right in front of the door.

Marisol Quintero (7:44 A.M.):
I can see that on the camera. Could you have the driver back into Dock 6 instead? It's empty until the 10:00 pickup.

Isaac Pereira (7:46 A.M.):
I could, but the dock leveler at Dock 6 isn't working right now. The maintenance team is replacing its hydraulic pump this morning.

Marisol Quintero (7:47 A.M.):
Ugh, I forgot about that. OK, I'll send Jalen over with a forklift to move the returns to the staging area. Give him about ten minutes.

Isaac Pereira (7:48 A.M.):
That works. I'll let the driver know there will be a short wait.

Marisol Quintero (7:49 A.M.):
Thanks. And please record the delay in the system so that Ottoline isn't charged a waiting fee.
passages.trans:
Isaac Pereira（上午 7:42）：
Marisol，Ottoline 食品的卡車剛開進場區，但 4 號碼頭還是被擋住了。夜班人員把兩棧板的退貨直接留在門口前面。

Marisol Quintero（上午 7:44）：
我在監視器上看到了。你可以請司機改倒車進 6 號碼頭嗎？那裡在 10 點的取貨之前都是空的。

Isaac Pereira（上午 7:46）：
是可以，但 6 號碼頭的調節板（dock leveler）現在不能用。維修組今天早上正在更換它的油壓泵。

Marisol Quintero（上午 7:47）：
唉，我把這件事忘了。好，我請 Jalen 開堆高機過去，把退貨移到暫存區。給他大約十分鐘。

Isaac Pereira（上午 7:48）：
可以。我會告訴司機要稍等一下。

Marisol Quintero（上午 7:49）：
謝謝。也請把這次延誤記錄到系統裡，這樣 Ottoline 就不會被收取等候費。
passages.en: Questions 147-148 refer to the following text-message chain.

passages.head:
Pinecrest Valley Water District
Notice of Scheduled Service Interruption
passages.text:
Pinecrest Valley Water District will replace an aging water main beneath Quarry Road between Jensen Street and Oriel Avenue. To complete this work safely, water service to homes and businesses on these blocks will be shut off on Tuesday, May 12, from 9:00 A.M. until approximately 4:00 P.M.

Before service is interrupted, we recommend that customers store enough drinking water to last the day. When service is restored, tap water may look cloudy for a short time. This is caused by trapped air and is not harmful. Simply run a cold-water faucet for a few minutes until the water is clear.

Quarry Road will remain open to traffic during the project, but street parking will not be permitted on the affected blocks from May 11 to May 13. Questions may be directed to our customer line at 555-0148, which is staffed weekdays from 8:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M.
passages.trans:
Pinecrest Valley 水務區
計畫性停水公告

Pinecrest Valley 水務區將更換 Quarry 路底下、介於 Jensen 街與 Oriel 大道之間的老舊自來水幹管。為了安全完成這項工程，這幾個街區的住家與商家將於 5 月 12 日（星期二）上午 9:00 至下午約 4:00 停止供水。

停水之前，我們建議用戶先儲存足夠當天使用的飲用水。恢復供水後，自來水可能會短時間呈現混濁。這是管內殘留空氣所造成，對人體無害。只要打開冷水龍頭放水幾分鐘，直到水變清澈即可。

工程期間 Quarry 路仍維持通車，但 5 月 11 日至 5 月 13 日期間，受影響街區禁止路邊停車。如有疑問，請撥打客服專線 555-0148，服務時間為平日上午 8:00 至下午 6:00。
passages.en: Questions 149-150 refer to the following notice.

passages.head: Inkwell Print Studio
passages.text:
Your business deserves to look its best. Since 2009, Inkwell Print Studio has produced business cards, brochures, banners, and product labels for companies throughout the Lakemont area.

New this month: same-day printing! Submit your files by 11:00 A.M., and your order will be ready for pickup by 5:00 P.M. that day. Same-day service is available for business cards and flyers only.

Not sure whether your design is ready to print? Our in-house designers will review your files at no charge and suggest adjustments before anything goes to press.

First-time customers receive 20 percent off any order of $100 or more. Simply enter the code INKNEW20 when ordering on our Web site, www.inkwellprint.com, or mention this advertisement at our counter at 312 Mallory Street.
passages.trans:
Inkwell 印刷工作室

您的事業值得以最好的形象示人。自 2009 年起，Inkwell 印刷工作室已為 Lakemont 地區各地的公司製作名片、宣傳手冊、布條與產品標籤。

本月新服務：當日印刷！只要在上午 11:00 前提交檔案，您的訂單當天下午 5:00 前即可取件。當日服務僅適用於名片與傳單。

不確定您的設計是否可以直接印刷？我們的駐店設計師會免費檢查您的檔案，並在付印前建議修改之處。

首次消費的顧客，訂單滿 100 美元即享八折優惠。在我們的網站 www.inkwellprint.com 訂購時輸入優惠碼 INKNEW20，或在 Mallory 街 312 號門市櫃檯出示本廣告即可。
passages.en: Questions 151-152 refer to the following advertisement.

passages.head:
Jasper Point Maritime Museum
Job Posting: Visitor Services Associate (Part-Time)
passages.text:
Jasper Point Maritime Museum, home to the region's largest collection of historic ship models and navigation instruments, is looking for a friendly and reliable Visitor Services Associate.

Responsibilities include selling admission tickets and memberships, answering visitors' questions, and leading short introductory tours of the main gallery. Associates also help prepare the education room for our weekend family workshops.

Applicants must be available to work at least two weekend days per month and should be comfortable speaking in front of groups of up to 25 people. Previous experience handling cash is required. Knowledge of a second language is a plus.

To apply, send a résumé to Pilar Ishikawa, Visitor Services Manager, at hiring@jasperpointmuseum.org by June 30.
passages.trans:
Jasper Point 海事博物館
徵才啟事：遊客服務專員（兼職）

Jasper Point 海事博物館收藏本地區規模最大的歷史船隻模型與航海儀器，現正徵求一位親切可靠的遊客服務專員。

職責包括販售門票與會員資格、回答遊客提問，以及帶領主展廳的簡短導覽。專員也需協助為週末親子工作坊布置教育教室。

應徵者每月須能在週末至少工作兩天，並應能自在地在最多 25 人的團體面前說話。須具備處理現金的經驗。懂第二種語言者尤佳。

應徵方式：請於 6 月 30 日前將履歷寄給遊客服務經理 Pilar Ishikawa，信箱為 hiring@jasperpointmuseum.org。
passages.en: Questions 153-154 refer to the following job posting.

passages.kind: 線上聊天討論 Online Chat Discussion
passages.head: Participants: Imani Lowell, Quentin Navarro, Patrick Ojukwu
passages.text:
Imani Lowell (2:05 P.M.):
Hi, Quentin and Patrick. Several people in the claims department are telling me they haven't been able to open shared files since this morning's software update. Is IT aware of the problem?

Quentin Navarro (2:07 P.M.):
Yes, we've received about a dozen tickets so far. The update moved the shared drive to a new server, and some computers are still pointing to the old address.

Imani Lowell (2:08 P.M.):
Is there anything my team can do in the meantime? We have client reports due at 5:00 today.

Patrick Ojukwu (2:10 P.M.):
Restarting the computer usually fixes it, since the new address loads when you log back in. Have your team try that first.

Imani Lowell (2:12 P.M.):
I'll pass that along. What if a restart doesn't work?

Patrick Ojukwu (2:13 P.M.):
Then submit a ticket marked "urgent," and one of us will connect to the computer remotely. We can usually fix it in under five minutes.

Quentin Navarro (2:15 P.M.):
We're also sending a company-wide e-mail with these instructions within the hour.

Imani Lowell (2:16 P.M.):
Great. Thanks, both of you.
passages.trans:
參與者：Imani Lowell、Quentin Navarro、Patrick Ojukwu

Imani Lowell（下午 2:05）：
嗨，Quentin、Patrick。理賠部門有好幾個人跟我說，自從今天早上的軟體更新之後，他們就打不開共用檔案。IT 部門知道這個問題嗎？

Quentin Navarro（下午 2:07）：
知道，目前我們已經收到大約十幾張工單。這次更新把共用磁碟移到了新的伺服器，有些電腦還指向舊的位址。

Imani Lowell（下午 2:08）：
在這段期間我的團隊能做些什麼嗎？我們今天 5 點前要交客戶報告。

Patrick Ojukwu（下午 2:10）：
重新開機通常就能解決，因為重新登入時會載入新的位址。請你的團隊先試試看。

Imani Lowell（下午 2:12）：
我會轉告他們。如果重開機也沒用呢？

Patrick Ojukwu（下午 2:13）：
那就提交一張標示「urgent（緊急）」的工單，我們會有人遠端連線到那台電腦。通常五分鐘內就能修好。

Quentin Navarro（下午 2:15）：
我們也會在一小時內發一封全公司的電子郵件，說明這些處理步驟。

Imani Lowell（下午 2:16）：
太好了。謝謝你們兩位。
passages.en: Questions 155-157 refer to the following online chat discussion.

passages.head:
To: Noah Pemberton <npemberton@mercerquilldesign.com>
From: Olivia Kowalski <okowalski@ironbridgepm.com>
Date: February 3
Subject: Lease renewal for Suite 410
passages.text:
Dear Mr. Pemberton,

Your lease for Suite 410 at Quincy Tower ends on April 30. On behalf of the building's owner, I am pleased to offer Mercer Quill Design a renewal on the terms described below. [1]

If you choose a three-year renewal, your monthly rent would rise from $4,200 to $4,350. A one-year renewal would be offered at $4,500 per month. [2] With either option, the owner will repaint the suite and replace the carpet in your conference room before the new term begins.

Please also be aware that the building's parking garage will be closed from June 1 to July 15 so that it can be resurfaced. [3] We apologize in advance for any inconvenience this may cause.

If you would like to renew, please let me know which option you prefer by March 1 so that I can prepare the paperwork. If we have not heard from you by that date, we will assume that you plan to move out, and we will begin showing the suite to prospective tenants. [4]

Best regards,

Olivia Kowalski
Leasing Manager, Ironbridge Property Management

passages.text:
Designed for working professionals, this six-course certificate program teaches the planning, budgeting, and communication skills needed to lead projects in any industry. Classes meet on Tuesday and Thursday evenings from 6:30 P.M. to 9:00 P.M. at our downtown campus, and every course is also offered in a live online format.

passages.head: Linden Falls Market to Stay Open All Winter
passages.text:
LINDEN FALLS (October 6) — For the first time in its 22-year history, the Linden Falls Farmers' Market will operate through the winter. Beginning November 7, the market will move from its summer location in Jessup Park to the former Corwin Brothers furniture warehouse on Main Street. It will be open there every Saturday from 9:00 A.M. to 1:00 P.M. until the end of March. [1]

Market manager Quinn Lindahl said the change was driven by demand from both shoppers and growers. "Every October, our customers ask where they can buy local food after the season ends," she said. "At the same time, many of our growers now use heated greenhouses, so they can offer fresh vegetables well into the colder months." [2]

The warehouse can hold about 40 vendor stalls, roughly two-thirds of the number at the summer market. [3] Stalls will be assigned according to how many years each vendor has taken part in the market, and applications are due by October 20. The weekly stall fee will be $35, the same rate charged during the summer.

The city, which owns the warehouse, has agreed to let the market use the building free of charge this winter. If the season is a success, organizers hope to reach a long-term agreement with the city. "We want to show that a year-round market can work in Linden Falls," said Mayor Ignacio Pardo. "So far, the response from residents has been very encouraging." [4]
passages.trans:
Linden Falls 市集將整個冬季持續營業

【Linden Falls 訊（10 月 6 日）】Linden Falls 農夫市集創立 22 年來，首度將在冬季持續營業。自 11 月 7 日起，市集將從夏季的 Jessup 公園場地，遷至 Main 街上原 Corwin Brothers 家具公司的倉庫。市集將在該處於每週六上午 9:00 至下午 1:00 營業，直到 3 月底。[1]

市集經理 Quinn Lindahl 表示，這項改變是因應消費者與農友雙方的需求。她說：「每年 10 月，顧客都會問我們產季結束後要去哪裡買在地食材。同時，我們許多農友現在都使用加溫溫室，因此到了較冷的月份仍能供應新鮮蔬菜。」[2]

該倉庫約可容納 40 個攤位，大約是夏季市集攤位數的三分之二。[3] 攤位將依各攤商參與市集的年資分配，申請截止日為 10 月 20 日。每週攤位費為 35 美元，與夏季收費相同。

擁有該倉庫的市政府已同意今年冬季免費出借建物給市集使用。若這一季營運成功，主辦單位希望能與市府達成長期協議。市長 Ignacio Pardo 表示：「我們希望證明全年營業的市集在 Linden Falls 是可行的。到目前為止，居民的反應非常令人振奮。」[4]

passages.head:
To: All Production Floor Employees
From: Jonah Petrakis, Plant Safety Manager
Date: August 18
Subject: Updated lockout procedures
passages.text:
Following last month's safety audit at our Ivesdale plant, Kapler Metalworks is updating its procedures for servicing machinery on the production floor. The auditors found that our current rules are sound but that they are not always followed consistently, particularly during night shifts.

Starting September 1, any employee who cleans, adjusts, or repairs a stamping press must first attach a personal padlock and a red warning tag to the machine's power switch. Each padlock will be labeled with the employee's name, and only that employee will be permitted to remove it. Supervisors will inspect every press at the start of each shift to confirm that no locks have been left on machines that are ready for use.

To prepare everyone for this change, the safety department will hold 45-minute training sessions in the break room on August 26, 27, and 28. Sessions will be offered at 7:00 A.M., 3:00 P.M., and 11:00 P.M. so that workers on all three shifts can attend without changing their schedules. Attendance is mandatory, and employees will be paid for their time.

Padlocks and tags will be handed out at the end of each session. If you lose your padlock, a replacement can be obtained from the tool crib. However, you will be asked to complete a short form explaining how it was lost.

Thank you for helping us keep Kapler a safe place to work.
passages.trans:
收件人：全體生產線員工
寄件人：Jonah Petrakis，廠區安全經理
日期：8 月 18 日
主旨：更新後的上鎖（停機）程序

繼上個月 Ivesdale 廠的安全稽核之後，Kapler 金屬加工公司將更新生產線上機具維修保養的程序。稽核人員發現，我們現行的規定本身是健全的，但並非總是被一致遵守，尤其是在夜班期間。

自 9 月 1 日起，任何員工在清潔、調整或維修沖壓機之前，都必須先在機器的電源開關上掛上個人專用的掛鎖與紅色警告吊牌。每個掛鎖都會標上該員工的姓名，且只有該員工本人可以將其取下。主管會在每一班開始時檢查每台沖壓機，確認準備使用的機器上沒有遺留任何鎖具。

為了讓大家為此項改變做好準備，安全部門將於 8 月 26、27、28 日在休息室舉辦 45 分鐘的訓練課程。課程時段為上午 7:00、下午 3:00 與晚上 11:00，讓三個班別的員工都不必調整班表就能參加。所有人都必須出席，且出席時間照常支薪。

掛鎖與吊牌將於每場課程結束時發放。若遺失掛鎖，可到工具室領取替換品，但須填寫一份簡短表格，說明遺失的經過。

感謝各位協助我們讓 Kapler 維持安全的工作環境。

Ms. Isabel Nakamura
415 Juniper Lane
Pella Springs, OR 97116

Dear Ms. Nakamura,
passages.text:
Thank you for being a subscriber to Kitchen Garden Monthly for the past six years. I am writing to let you know about some important changes to the magazine.

Beginning with the January issue, Kitchen Garden Monthly will become Kitchen Garden Quarterly. Instead of twelve issues a year, subscribers will receive four larger issues, each about twice the length of a current issue. The new format will allow our writers to explore each growing season in greater depth, with more step-by-step projects and interviews with expert growers. Each issue will also feature a new section on growing herbs and vegetables indoors.

In addition, every subscription will now include full access to our new online library, which contains every article we have published since 2008. Subscribers will also receive a weekly e-mail newsletter with planting reminders tailored to their region. To sign in to the library, simply visit www.kitchengardenmag.com and enter your subscriber number, which is printed above your name on the mailing label of every issue.

Your current subscription runs through next June. Because you will receive fewer printed issues, we will extend your subscription by three months, through September, at no cost to you. No action is needed on your part. However, if you would prefer a partial refund instead, please call our subscriber services team at 555-0126 by October 31.

We are excited about this new direction for the magazine, and we hope you will be, too.

Sincerely,

Mira Jankowski
Subscriber Services Director

自明年 1 月號起，《Kitchen Garden Monthly》將改為《Kitchen Garden Quarterly（廚房菜園季刊）》。訂戶每年將收到四期篇幅較大的刊物，而非十二期，每期篇幅約為目前的兩倍。新的形式能讓我們的作者更深入地探討每個栽種季節，提供更多逐步教學的實作單元，以及專業種植者的訪談。每期也將新增一個介紹室內種植香草與蔬菜的專欄。

此外，每份訂閱今後都將包含我們新的線上資料庫的完整使用權限，其中收錄了本刊自 2008 年以來刊登的所有文章。訂戶也將每週收到一份電子報，提供依其所在地區量身打造的種植提醒。若要登入資料庫，只要造訪 www.kitchengardenmag.com 並輸入您的訂戶編號即可，編號印在每期郵寄標籤上您的姓名上方。

您目前的訂閱期限到明年 6 月。由於您將收到的紙本期數變少，我們將免費為您延長三個月的訂閱期，至 9 月為止。您不需要做任何處理。但如果您希望改為退還部分費用，請於 10 月 31 日前致電訂戶服務團隊 555-0126。

我們對本刊的新方向感到興奮，也希望您同樣期待。

謹啟

Mira Jankowski
訂戶服務部主任

docs.head:
Port Ismay Regional Transit (PIRT)
Route 14 Service Changes — Effective Monday, March 2
docs.text:
To reduce crowding during rush hour, PIRT is adding trips to Route 14 (Kellerman Station to Quayside Medical Center) and adjusting its timetable. Weekday morning departures from Kellerman Station will be as follows:

6:10 A.M. | 6:30 A.M. | 6:45 A.M. | 7:00 A.M. | 7:15 A.M. | 7:35 A.M. | 8:00 A.M.

The trip from Kellerman Station to Quayside Medical Center, the last stop on the route, takes approximately 35 minutes. Please note that the stop at Lindell Avenue and Pike Street will be permanently closed. Riders should use the new stop one block north, at Lindell Avenue and Brenton Street. Weekend service is not affected by these changes.

Updated printed timetables are available at all PIRT stations, and real-time arrival information can be found on the PIRT mobile app.

docs.head:
To: customerservice@pirt.org
From: Kofi Mensah <kmensah@quickmail.com>
Date: March 9
Subject: Route 14 morning service
docs.text:
Hello,

I have taken Route 14 from Kellerman Station to work every weekday for the past four years, and I appreciate the extra trips. Before the timetable changed, I rode the 6:40 A.M. bus, which got me to the last stop in plenty of time for my 7:30 shift. Now I take the first bus after 6:40, and it arrives just before my shift starts. On two occasions last week, it ran late and I was not able to clock in on time.

Would PIRT consider moving that departure five minutes earlier? Many of my coworkers at the hospital ride the same bus and have had the same problem.

Also, the new stop on Lindell Avenue has no shelter or bench, unlike the old one. With the rainy season starting, a shelter there would be very welcome.

Thank you,
Kofi Mensah

docs.head:
Nimbus Home Appliances
Voluntary Recall: Pour-Over Electric Kettles
Media contact: Paolo Iverson, 555-0170
docs.text:
Nimbus Home Appliances is voluntarily recalling about 18,000 electric kettles sold between June 1 and September 30 because the handle can separate from the body of the kettle, posing a burn hazard. No injuries have been reported.

The recall affects the following models, which were sold in stores and online:
Model PK-100 (1.0 liter, white)
Model PK-120 (1.2 liter, black)
Model PK-150 (1.5 liter, stainless steel)

Customers should stop using the affected kettles immediately. The model number is printed on the bottom of the base. Owners of an affected kettle may choose either a full refund or a free replacement kettle of an updated design. To request one, visit www.nimbushome.com/recall or call 555-0177. A prepaid shipping label will be provided for returning the recalled kettle; customers should not bring kettles back to the store where they were purchased.

The 1.7-liter Model PK-200 is not included in this recall.

docs.head:

From: Lucia Ortega <lortega@pinmail.com>
Date: October 14
Subject: Kettle recall
docs.text:
Hello,

I heard about the kettle recall on the news last night. In August, I bought a Nimbus kettle as a gift for my parents, and when I checked the base, I found that it is a 1.2-liter model. They have used it every morning without any trouble, but I have asked them to stop using it for now.

I would like to receive the updated kettle rather than my money back, since my parents really like the design. Could the replacement be shipped directly to their address (27 Ilford Court, Ashgrove Falls) instead of mine? Also, the original box was thrown away. Will that be a problem when we send the kettle back?

Best regards,
Lucia Ortega

Voluntary Recall: Pour-Over Electric Kettles
Media contact: Paolo Iverson, 555-0170
Nimbus Home Appliances is voluntarily recalling about 18,000 electric kettles sold between June 1 and September 30 because the handle can separate from the body of the kettle, posing a burn hazard. No injuries have been reported.

The recall affects the following models, which were sold in stores and online:
Model PK-100 (1.0 liter, white)
Model PK-120 (1.2 liter, black)
Model PK-150 (1.5 liter, stainless steel)

Customers should stop using the affected kettles immediately. The model number is printed on the bottom of the base. Owners of an affected kettle may choose either a full refund or a free replacement kettle of an updated design. To request one, visit www.nimbushome.com/recall or call 555-0177. A prepaid shipping label will be provided for returning the recalled kettle; customers should not bring kettles back to the store where they were purchased.

The 1.7-liter Model PK-200 is not included in this recall.

Subject: Kettle recall

I heard about the kettle recall on the news last night. In August, I bought a Nimbus kettle as a gift for my parents, and when I checked the base, I found that it is a 1.2-liter model. They have used it every morning without any trouble, but I have asked them to stop using it for now.

I would like to receive the updated kettle rather than my money back, since my parents really like the design. Could the replacement be shipped directly to their address (27 Ilford Court, Ashgrove Falls) instead of mine? Also, the original box was thrown away. Will that be a problem when we send the kettle back?

Best regards,
Lucia Ortega

Subject: Invitation to a taste-test study
docs.text:
Dear Mr. Ishida,

Based on your answers to our online questionnaire last month, you have been selected to take part in a taste-test study for a new line of sparkling teas. Each session lasts 90 minutes and takes place at our research center at 60 Lamont Street. Participants will sample several drinks and then discuss their opinions in a small group led by one of our moderators.

As a thank-you, each participant will receive a $75 gift card at the end of the session. Participants who also complete a short follow-up survey within one week of their session will receive an additional $25.

Please choose a session from the attached schedule and reply by November 10. Because the drinks contain caffeine, the study is open only to adults who regularly drink tea or coffee.

Sincerely,
Natalia Kerr
Study Coordinator, Insight Loop Research

A loading area is obstructed by some merchandise.
A delivery is missing two pallets.
qs.h: 看 7:42 A.M. Mr. Pereira 的第一則訊息：4 號碼頭為什麼不能用？
qs.trans: Pereira 先生回報了什麼問題？
qs.e: 7:42 A.M. Mr. Pereira 說「Dock 4 is still blocked. The overnight crew left two pallets of returned goods right in front of the door.」，也就是卸貨碼頭被退貨棧板擋住。blocked 對應 obstructed，returned goods 對應 merchandise，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 卡車已正確開進場區，並沒有走錯倉庫；(B) 壞掉的是 6 號碼頭的調節板（dock leveler），不是堆高機，堆高機反而要用來搬退貨；(D) 兩棧板是擋在門口的退貨，不是貨物短少。

qs.q: At 7:47 A.M., what does Ms. Quintero most likely mean when she writes, "Ugh, I forgot about that"?
o: She realizes that her suggestion will not work.
She did not remember to schedule a pickup.
She forgot to tell the driver about a delay.
She neglected to order a replacement part.
qs.h: 對照 7:44 A.M. 她提出的建議，以及 7:46 A.M. Mr. Pereira 回覆的狀況。
qs.trans: 在上午 7:47，Quintero 女士寫道「Ugh, I forgot about that（唉，我把這件事忘了）」最可能是什麼意思？
qs.e: 7:44 A.M. Ms. Quintero 建議讓司機改用 6 號碼頭，但 7:46 A.M. Mr. Pereira 提醒「the dock leveler at Dock 6 isn't working right now」。她回「I forgot about that」表示她忘了 6 號碼頭正在維修，意識到自己的建議行不通，接著才改派 Jalen 去搬退貨，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 10 點的取貨早已排定，她並沒有忘記安排；(C) 要通知司機稍候的是 Mr. Pereira（7:48 A.M.），且這是之後才發生的事；(D) 維修組已在更換油壓泵，文中沒有說她忘了訂零件。

qs.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
o: To announce an increase in water rates
To explain how to report a leak
To introduce a new customer service number
To inform residents about a planned temporary shutoff
qs.h: 看標題 Notice of Scheduled Service Interruption 與第一段的主要內容。
qs.trans: 這則公告的目的是什麼？
qs.e: 標題為「Notice of Scheduled Service Interruption」，第一段說明因更換水管，「water service ... will be shut off on Tuesday, May 12, from 9:00 A.M. until approximately 4:00 P.M.」，目的是通知居民計畫中的暫時停水，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 文中沒有提到調漲水費；(B) 沒有說明如何通報漏水；(C) 客服專線 555-0148 只是提供諮詢管道，並非新設專線。

qs.q: According to the notice, what should customers do if their tap water looks cloudy?
o: Call the customer line immediately
Let cold water flow from a faucet for a while
Avoid drinking tap water until May 13
Boil the water before using it
qs.h: 看第二段 cloudy 之後的說明：水混濁時只要怎麼做？
qs.trans: 根據公告，如果自來水看起來混濁，用戶應該怎麼做？
qs.e: 第二段說水混濁是空氣造成、無害，「Simply run a cold-water faucet for a few minutes until the water is clear.」，即讓冷水龍頭流幾分鐘，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 客服專線是一般諮詢用，文中沒有要求水混濁時立刻打電話；(C) 5 月 13 日是禁止路邊停車的結束日，與飲水無關；(D) 文中說混濁無害，沒有要求煮沸。

qs.q: What is indicated about the same-day service?
o: It applies to a limited range of products.
It requires an additional fee.
Orders for it must be submitted by 5:00 P.M.
It is available only to first-time customers.
qs.h: 看第二段 same-day printing 的最後一句限制條件。
qs.trans: 關於當日服務，文中提到了什麼？
qs.e: 第二段最後一句說「Same-day service is available for business cards and flyers only.」，只適用於名片與傳單，也就是限於部分產品，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 文中沒有提到當日服務要加價；(C) 檔案要在上午 11:00 前提交，下午 5:00 是取件時間；(D) 「首次消費」是八折優惠的條件，不是當日服務的條件。

qs.q: What does Inkwell Print Studio offer at no cost?
o: Delivery of large orders
A set of sample business cards
An evaluation of customers' design files
The creation of a new company logo
qs.h: 找出文中 at no charge 出現的那一段。
qs.trans: Inkwell 印刷工作室免費提供什麼？
qs.e: 第三段說「Our in-house designers will review your files at no charge and suggest adjustments」，設計師會免費檢查顧客的檔案，review your files 即 an evaluation of customers' design files，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 文中只提到到門市取件（pickup），沒有提到送貨；(B) 名片是販售的產品，並沒有免費樣品；(D) 設計師是檢查顧客的現有檔案，不是免費設計新標誌。

qs.q: What is suggested about the Visitor Services Associate position?
o: It is a full-time position.
It involves addressing groups of visitors.
It includes repairing historic ship models.
It requires a background in navigation.
qs.h: 對照第二段的職責與第三段對應徵者的要求，找出兩段共同指向的工作內容。
qs.trans: 關於遊客服務專員這個職位，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第二段職責包括「leading short introductory tours of the main gallery」，第三段又要求應徵者「comfortable speaking in front of groups of up to 25 people」，可推知這份工作需要對團體遊客說話、解說，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 標題寫明 Part-Time，是兼職；(C) 船隻模型是館藏，職責中沒有修復工作；(D) 航海儀器是館藏內容，並沒有要求應徵者具航海背景。

qs.q: What is NOT a requirement for applicants?
o: Availability on some weekends
Experience with handling money
Comfort with speaking to groups
The ability to speak another language
qs.h: NOT 題：逐一核對第三段的各項條件，注意每項條件的措辭是「必須」還是另有說法。
qs.trans: 下列何者「不是」應徵者必須具備的條件？
qs.e: 第三段最後一句說「Knowledge of a second language is a plus.」，懂第二語言只是加分（a plus），並非必要條件，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 「must be available to work at least two weekend days per month」是必要條件；(B) 「Previous experience handling cash is required」；(C) 「should be comfortable speaking in front of groups」也是對應徵者的要求。

qs.q: What has caused the problem with the shared files?
o: A computer virus has damaged several files.
Employees have entered incorrect passwords.
Some computers are not connecting to a new server location.
The claims department has exceeded its storage limit.
qs.h: 看 2:07 P.M. Mr. Navarro 對問題原因的說明。
qs.trans: 是什麼造成共用檔案的問題？
qs.e: 2:07 P.M. Mr. Navarro 說「The update moved the shared drive to a new server, and some computers are still pointing to the old address.」，也就是部分電腦仍連到舊位址、沒有連上新伺服器，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 文中沒有提到電腦病毒；(B) 沒有提到密碼輸入錯誤；(D) 沒有提到儲存空間超過上限。

qs.q: At 2:12 P.M., what does Ms. Lowell most likely mean when she writes, "I'll pass that along"?
o: She will share the suggestion with her coworkers.
She will forward a ticket to the IT department.
She will send the client reports to Mr. Navarro.
She will skip the restart and submit a ticket.
qs.h: 看前一則 2:10 P.M. Mr. Ojukwu 的訊息：that 指的是什麼？Ms. Lowell 接下來要把它告訴誰？
qs.trans: 在下午 2:12，Lowell 女士寫道「I'll pass that along（我會轉告）」最可能是什麼意思？
qs.e: 2:10 P.M. Mr. Ojukwu 建議重新開機，並說「Have your team try that first.」。Ms. Lowell 回覆「I'll pass that along」，pass along 意為「轉達」，表示她會把重開機的建議轉告團隊成員，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 提交工單是重開機無效後才要做的事，且是由使用者提交，不是她轉交；(C) 客戶報告是要交給客戶的，與 Mr. Navarro 無關；(D) Mr. Ojukwu 要大家先重開機，她並沒有要跳過這一步。

qs.q: What is suggested about Ms. Lowell's team?
o: It has submitted about a dozen tickets.
It needs to finish some work later in the day.
It recently moved to a new office.
It will receive new computers soon.
qs.h: 看 2:08 P.M. Ms. Lowell 為什麼急著問現在能做什麼。
qs.trans: 關於 Lowell 女士的團隊，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 2:08 P.M. Ms. Lowell 說「We have client reports due at 5:00 today.」，對話時間是下午兩點多，可知她的團隊當天稍晚有工作必須完成，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 十幾張工單是 IT 部門目前收到的總數（全公司），並非她的團隊提交的；(C) 搬到新伺服器的是共用磁碟，不是團隊搬辦公室；(D) 文中沒有提到要換新電腦。

qs.q: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
o: To request an overdue rent payment
To announce the sale of a building
To invite a client to view a new office
To present options for extending a rental agreement
qs.h: 看主旨 Lease renewal 與第一段的 I am pleased to offer ... a renewal。
qs.trans: 這封電子郵件的目的是什麼？
qs.e: 主旨為「Lease renewal for Suite 410」，第一段說「I am pleased to offer Mercer Quill Design a renewal on the terms described below」，第二段接著列出三年與一年兩種續約方案。lease renewal 即延長租約，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 信中沒有提到欠繳租金；(B) Ms. Kowalski 是代表業主提出續約，並沒有說大樓要出售；(C) 帶人參觀（showing the suite）是對潛在新租戶，而且是收件人未回覆時才會發生。

qs.q: According to the e-mail, what will happen if Mr. Pemberton does not respond by March 1?
o: The suite will be shown to other potential renters.
The lease will automatically be renewed for one year.
The monthly rent will increase to $4,500.
The conference room carpet will not be replaced.
qs.h: 看第四段 If we have not heard from you by that date 之後的內容。
qs.trans: 根據電子郵件，如果 Pemberton 先生在 3 月 1 日前沒有回覆，會發生什麼事？
qs.e: 第四段說「If we have not heard from you by that date, we will assume that you plan to move out, and we will begin showing the suite to prospective tenants.」，也就是會開始帶潛在租戶看房，prospective tenants 對應 potential renters，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 未回覆會被視為要遷出，而不是自動續約；(C) $4,500 是選擇一年續約時的月租，與未回覆無關；(D) 更換地毯是兩種續約方案都包含的條件，文中沒有說未回覆就不更換。

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"While the work is under way, tenants may park free of charge in the city-owned garage on Pell Street."
qs.h: 句中的 the work 指的是哪一項工程？為什麼租戶需要到別的車庫停車？找出前一句提到工程與停車的位置。
qs.trans:
下列句子最適合填入標示 [1]、[2]、[3]、[4] 的哪一個位置？
「在施工期間，租戶可以免費停在 Pell 街的市營停車場。」
qs.e: [3] 的前一句說「the building's parking garage will be closed from June 1 to July 15 so that it can be resurfaced」，大樓停車場因重鋪路面而關閉，待插入句的 the work 正是指這項重鋪工程，並提供替代停車方案，後面再接致歉句，語意最連貫，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) [1] 前一句只是說明要提供續約方案，沒有任何工程；(B) [2] 前一句在講一年續約的租金，與停車無關；(D) [4] 前一句在講未回覆就帶人看房，放停車資訊不合邏輯。

qs.q: What is stated about the certificate program?
o: It consists of twelve courses.
It is intended for people who have jobs.
It requires applicants to pass an exam before enrolling.
It is offered only at the downtown campus.
qs.h: 看第一段第一句 Designed for ... 說明這個課程是為誰設計的。
qs.trans: 關於這個證書課程，文中提到了什麼？
qs.e: 第一段開頭說「Designed for working professionals」，課程是為在職人士設計的，working professionals 對應 people who have jobs，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 課程共六門（six-course），十二是完成所需的月數；(C) 考試是修完課程後才有資格參加，並非入學條件；(D) 每門課也提供線上直播（live online format），不只在市中心校區。

qs.q: What is NOT mentioned as a feature of the program?
o: A reduced price for some participants
Assistance with finding a new job
Coverage of the cost of an exam
The option of attending classes online
qs.h: NOT 題：逐一回到第一至第三段核對，哪一項完全沒有出現？
qs.trans: 下列何者「沒有」被提到是該課程的特色？
qs.e: 網頁中完全沒有提到協助學員找工作或就業媒合，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 第三段提到企業合作夥伴的員工享九折（10 percent discount）；(C) 第二段說「tuition includes the fee for one attempt at the exam」；(D) 第一段說每門課都提供「live online format」。

qs.q: What is suggested about students who earn a grade below B in any of the courses?
o: They must pay a late registration fee.
They will be moved to an online class.
They will lose their corporate partner discount.
They will not qualify to take the board exam.
qs.h: 看第二段應考資格的條件：要怎樣才 eligible to take the ... exam？
qs.trans: 關於任何一門課成績低於 B 的學生，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第二段說「Participants who finish all six courses with a grade of B or higher are eligible to take the Project Leadership Board exam」，必須六門課都達 B 以上才有應考資格，因此有一門低於 B 的學生就無法取得考試資格，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 文中沒有提到逾期報名費，也與成績無關；(B) 線上上課是學生可自行選擇的方式，與成績無關；(C) 折扣取決於雇主是否為合作企業，與成績無關。

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
o: A change in when and where a market operates
The closing of a local furniture business
A greenhouse project funded by the city
The results of a survey of local shoppers
qs.h: 看標題與第一段：市集今年冬天有什麼改變？
qs.trans: 這篇報導主要是關於什麼？
qs.e: 標題為「Linden Falls Market to Stay Open All Winter」，第一段說市集首度在冬季營業，並將從 Jessup 公園遷到 Main 街的倉庫，每週六營業。全文圍繞市集營業期間與地點的改變，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) Corwin Brothers 只是倉庫原本的使用者（former ... warehouse），報導重點不是家具店歇業；(C) 溫室是農友自己使用的，市府提供的是免費借用倉庫；(D) 文中只提到顧客常詢問，並沒有進行問卷調查。

qs.q: What is indicated about the stall fees for the winter market?
o: They will be waived for the first winter.
They must be paid by October 20.
They will be the same as in the summer.
They will depend on the size of each stall.
qs.h: 看第三段最後一句 stall fee 的說明。
qs.trans: 關於冬季市集的攤位費，文中提到了什麼？
qs.e: 第三段最後一句說「The weekly stall fee will be $35, the same rate charged during the summer.」，攤位費和夏季相同，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 免費的是市府出借倉庫給市集（free of charge），不是攤位費；(B) 10 月 20 日是攤位申請截止日，不是繳費期限；(D) 攤位費一律每週 35 美元，文中沒有依攤位大小計價。

qs.q: In the article, the word "hold" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
o: grip
conduct
delay
accommodate
qs.h: 把選項代回原句「The warehouse can ___ about 40 vendor stalls」，倉庫和攤位的關係是什麼？
qs.trans: 在報導第三段中，「hold」一詞的意思最接近下列何者？
qs.e: 原句「The warehouse can hold about 40 vendor stalls」意思是倉庫可「容納」約 40 個攤位，hold 在此指空間上的容納，與 accommodate 最接近，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) grip 是用手「握住」；(B) conduct 是「舉行」（如 hold a meeting）；(C) delay 是「延遲」（如 hold up），代回原句都不通。

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"As a result, not every vendor from the summer market will be offered a stall this winter."
qs.h: As a result 表示前一句是原因：什麼原因會導致不是每個攤商都能分到攤位？
qs.trans:
下列句子最適合填入標示 [1]、[2]、[3]、[4] 的哪一個位置？
「因此，並非每一個夏季市集的攤商今年冬天都能分到攤位。」
qs.e: [3] 的前一句說倉庫只能容納約 40 個攤位，「roughly two-thirds of the number at the summer market」，攤位數比夏季少，所以「As a result」不是每個攤商都能分到攤位；後一句接著說明攤位依年資分配，語意完全銜接，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) [1] 前一句只說明營業時間與月份，與攤位數量無關；(B) [2] 前一句說農友冬天仍有蔬菜可賣，接「因此攤位不夠」不合邏輯；(D) [4] 前一句是市長說居民反應熱烈，也無法推出攤位不足的結果。

qs.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
o: To report an accident that occurred during a night shift
To explain a revised safety procedure and related training
To announce the results of a hiring review
To introduce a new line of stamping presses
qs.h: 看主旨 Updated lockout procedures，以及第二、三段分別在講什麼。
qs.trans: 這份備忘錄的目的是什麼？
qs.e: 主旨為「Updated lockout procedures」，第一段說公司「is updating its procedures for servicing machinery」，第二段說明新規定，第三段說明相關的訓練課程。備忘錄是在說明修訂後的安全程序及訓練，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 夜班只是稽核發現規定較常沒被遵守的時段，並沒有發生事故；(C) 稽核是安全稽核（safety audit），與招募無關；(D) 沖壓機是現有機器，沒有推出新機種。

qs.q: According to the memo, who is allowed to remove a padlock from a machine?
o: The employee whose name appears on it
Any supervisor on duty
A member of the safety department
A worker at the tool crib
qs.h: 看第二段 Each padlock will be labeled ... 那一句。
qs.trans: 根據備忘錄，誰可以把掛鎖從機器上取下？
qs.e: 第二段說「Each padlock will be labeled with the employee's name, and only that employee will be permitted to remove it.」，只有名字標在鎖上的那位員工可以取下，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 主管只負責每班開始時檢查機器，沒有說可以取下別人的鎖；(C) 安全部門負責舉辦訓練課程；(D) 工具室只是補發遺失掛鎖的地方。

qs.q: What is NOT stated about the training sessions?
o: They will last less than one hour.
Employees will be paid for attending them.
They will be offered at three different times of day.
They will be led by the outside auditors.
qs.h: NOT 題：逐一核對第三段對訓練課程的每一項描述。
qs.trans: 關於訓練課程，下列何者「沒有」被提到？
qs.e: 第三段說「the safety department will hold 45-minute training sessions」，課程由公司的安全部門舉辦，文中從未說由外部稽核人員帶領，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 課程為 45 分鐘（45-minute），少於一小時；(B) 「employees will be paid for their time」；(C) 課程在上午 7:00、下午 3:00、晚上 11:00 三個時段舉行。

qs.q: What is suggested about Kapler Metalworks?
o: It did not pass its most recent safety audit.
It plans to open a second plant.
It runs its production floor around the clock.
It charges employees for lost padlocks.
qs.h: 看第三段訓練課程的時段安排，以及第一段提到的 night shifts。
qs.trans: 關於 Kapler 金屬加工公司，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第一段提到夜班（night shifts），第三段說課程在上午 7:00、下午 3:00、晚上 11:00 舉行，「so that workers on all three shifts can attend」。工廠有三個班別、從早到深夜都有人上班，可推知生產線是 24 小時運作，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 稽核發現「our current rules are sound」，問題只是執行不一致，並沒有說未通過；(B) 文中沒有提到要開第二座工廠；(D) 遺失掛鎖只需填寫說明表格，沒有說要付費。

qs.q: What change is being made to the magazine?
o: It will be published less often.
It will no longer be available in print.
Its subject will change from cooking to gardening.
Its subscription price will increase.
qs.h: 看第二段 Monthly 改為 Quarterly，以及期數的變化。
qs.trans: 這本雜誌將有什麼改變？
qs.e: 第二段說「Kitchen Garden Monthly will become Kitchen Garden Quarterly. Instead of twelve issues a year, subscribers will receive four larger issues」，由月刊改為季刊，每年從十二期減為四期，也就是出刊頻率降低，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 仍有紙本，只是期數變少（fewer printed issues）；(C) 雜誌一直是園藝主題，沒有從烹飪改成園藝；(D) 文中沒有提到漲價，反而免費延長訂閱期。

qs.q: In the letter, the word "runs" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to
o: manages
hurries
continues
competes
qs.h: 把選項代回原句「Your current subscription ___ through next June」，看哪個意思通順。
qs.trans: 在信件第四段中，「runs」一詞的意思最接近下列何者？
qs.e: 原句「Your current subscription runs through next June」意思是您目前的訂閱「持續、有效」到明年 6 月，run 在此指期間的延續，與 continues 最接近，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) manages 是「經營、管理」（如 run a business）；(B) hurries 是「趕快、跑」；(D) competes 是「參選、競爭」（如 run for office），代回原句都不通。

qs.q: What is suggested about Ms. Nakamura's subscription?
o: It began in 2008.
It will be extended even if she does nothing.
It will cost more after January.
It will end next June.
qs.h: 看第四段：她的訂閱期限會有什麼變化？她需要採取什麼行動嗎？
qs.trans: 關於 Nakamura 女士的訂閱，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第四段說「we will extend your subscription by three months, through September, at no cost to you. No action is needed on your part.」，她不需要做任何事，訂閱就會自動延長三個月，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 2008 年是線上資料庫收錄文章的起始年份，她是過去六年訂閱；(C) 文中沒有提到漲價；(D) 原本到明年 6 月，但已免費延長至 9 月。

qs.q: According to the letter, what will subscribers receive every week?
o: A printed planting calendar
Invitations to interviews with expert growers
A discount on gardening supplies
Gardening reminders suited to where they live
qs.h: 找出第三段中 weekly 的那一句。
qs.trans: 根據信件，訂戶每週會收到什麼？
qs.e: 第三段說「Subscribers will also receive a weekly e-mail newsletter with planting reminders tailored to their region.」，每週會收到依地區量身打造的種植提醒，tailored to their region 對應 suited to where they live，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 每週的提醒是以電子報寄送，不是紙本日曆；(B) 專家訪談是季刊內容的一部分，不是每週的邀請；(C) 文中沒有提到園藝用品折扣。

qs.q: What is the purpose of the Web page?
o: To announce changes to a bus route
To introduce a new mobile app
To explain an increase in fares
To announce the opening of a new station
qs.h: 看第一篇標題 Route 14 Service Changes 與第一段第一句。
qs.trans: 這個網頁的目的是什麼？
qs.e: 第一篇標題為「Route 14 Service Changes」，第一句說 PIRT「is adding trips to Route 14 ... and adjusting its timetable」，接著說明新的發車時間與站牌異動，目的是公告公車路線的變更，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 手機 App 是原本就有的查詢管道，並非新推出；(C) 文中完全沒有提到票價；(D) 只有新設站牌（new stop），沒有新車站啟用。

qs.q: According to the Web page, what will happen to the stop at Lindell Avenue and Pike Street?
o: It will get a new shelter.
It will no longer be served by buses.
It will be used only on weekends.
It will be moved one block south.
qs.h: 看第一篇第三段 Please note that ... 那一句。
qs.trans: 根據網頁，Lindell 大道與 Pike 街口的站牌會怎麼樣？
qs.e: 第一篇第三段說「the stop at Lindell Avenue and Pike Street will be permanently closed」，該站牌將永久裁撤，公車不再停靠，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 第二篇反而抱怨新站牌沒有候車亭，文中沒有說要加裝；(C) 「Weekend service is not affected」是指週末班次不變，不是只在週末使用；(D) 新站牌在往「北」一個街區（one block north）。

qs.q: Which bus does Mr. Mensah most likely take now?
o: The 6:30 A.M. bus
The 6:45 A.M. bus
The 7:00 A.M. bus
The 7:15 A.M. bus
qs.h: 第二篇說他現在搭「6:40 之後的第一班車」，回第一篇的新時刻表找出是哪一班。
qs.trans: Mensah 先生現在最可能搭哪一班公車？
qs.e: 第二篇說「Now I take the first bus after 6:40」，對照第一篇的新時刻表，6:40 之後的第一班是 6:45 A.M.；加上約 35 分鐘車程約 7:20 到站，也符合他說的「arrives just before my shift starts」（7:30 上班），故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 6:30 早於 6:40，不是 6:40 之後的班次；(C) 7:00 發車約 7:35 才到，會超過 7:30 的上班時間；(D) 7:15 發車更晚，不可能在上班前抵達。

qs.q: What is suggested about Mr. Mensah?
o: He recently moved closer to Kellerman Station.
He rides Route 14 mainly on weekends.
He is employed at a medical facility.
He has worked at his current job for less than a year.
qs.h: 看第二篇第二段他怎麼稱呼一起搭車的同事。
qs.trans: 關於 Mensah 先生，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第二篇第二段說「Many of my coworkers at the hospital ride the same bus」，他的同事在醫院工作，加上他搭車到終點站上班，可推知他在醫療機構工作，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 文中沒有提到他最近搬家；(B) 他是「every weekday（每個平日）」搭車上班；(D) 他已經搭這條路線上班四年（for the past four years）。

qs.q: What does Mr. Mensah request in addition to a schedule change?
o: A refund for a monthly pass
Updated printed timetables
Additional weekend service
A shelter at a bus stop
qs.h: 看第二篇最後一段 Also 之後的內容。
qs.trans: 除了更改時刻之外，Mensah 先生還提出了什麼要求？
qs.e: 第二篇最後一段說新站牌「has no shelter or bench」，並表示「a shelter there would be very welcome」，希望在站牌設置候車亭，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 他沒有提到月票或退款；(B) 紙本時刻表是第一篇說各站已經提供的；(C) 他平日搭車，沒有要求增加週末班次。

qs.q: Why are the kettles being recalled?
o: A part of them may come loose.
They can overheat when empty.
Several customers were injured by them.
Their power cords are too short.
qs.h: 看第一篇第一段 because 後面的原因。
qs.trans: 這些水壺為什麼被召回？
qs.e: 第一篇第一段說召回的原因是「the handle can separate from the body of the kettle」，把手可能和壺身分離，也就是零件可能鬆脫，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 文中沒有提到空燒過熱；(C) 文中明確說「No injuries have been reported」；(D) 沒有提到電源線。

qs.q: What is NOT indicated about the recall in the press release?
o: It covers kettles bought during a four-month period.
It involves products of three different sizes.
It gives customers a choice of remedies.
It offers a discount on future purchases.
qs.h: NOT 題：逐一回第一篇核對銷售期間、型號容量、處理方式。
qs.trans: 關於這次召回，新聞稿中「沒有」提到下列哪一項？
qs.e: 新聞稿只提供全額退款或免費更換兩種處理方式，完全沒有提到未來購物折扣，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 召回產品是 6 月 1 日至 9 月 30 日售出的，正好四個月；(B) 三個型號分別為 1.0、1.2、1.5 公升；(C) 顧客可選擇「either a full refund or a free replacement kettle」。

qs.q: Which model did Ms. Ortega most likely purchase?
o: Model PK-100
Model PK-120
Model PK-150
Model PK-200
qs.h: 第二篇她說底座顯示的容量是多少？再回第一篇的型號清單對照。
qs.trans: Ortega 女士最可能購買的是哪一個型號？
qs.e: 第二篇說「I found that it is a 1.2-liter model」，對照第一篇的清單，1.2 公升的是「Model PK-120 (1.2 liter, black)」；她 8 月購買，也落在 6 月 1 日至 9 月 30 日的召回範圍內，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) PK-100 是 1.0 公升；(C) PK-150 是 1.5 公升；(D) PK-200 是 1.7 公升，且不在召回範圍內。

qs.q: What does Ms. Ortega indicate about her parents?
o: They purchased the kettle online.
They would prefer to get a refund.
They have not had any problems with the kettle.
They live at the same address as Ms. Ortega.
qs.h: 看第二篇第一段後半句與第二段，她怎麼描述父母使用水壺的情形？
qs.trans: Ortega 女士提到了她父母的什麼事？
qs.e: 第二篇第一段說「They have used it every morning without any trouble」，父母每天使用都沒有發生問題，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 水壺是 Ms. Ortega 買來送父母的禮物，文中沒有說在網路上購買；(B) 她說因為父母喜歡這個設計，想要換新品而不是退款；(D) 她請公司把替換品寄到父母的地址「instead of mine」，可見兩者住址不同。

qs.q: In the press release, the word "posing" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
o: asking
presenting
modeling
pretending
qs.h: 把選項代回原句「posing a burn hazard」，pose 搭配 hazard／risk 時是什麼意思？
qs.trans: 在新聞稿第一段中，「posing」一詞的意思最接近下列何者？
qs.e: 原句說把手可能脫落，「posing a burn hazard」，pose a hazard 意為「造成、構成危險」，與 presenting（帶來、構成）最接近，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) asking 是 pose a question（提出問題）的意思；(C) modeling 是擺姿勢拍照（pose for a photo）；(D) pretending 是假扮（pose as），代回原句都不通。

qs.q: What is indicated in the estimate?
o: A partial payment is required in advance.
The prices will remain valid for 90 days.
The new flooring will be made of wood.
New lights will be installed in the waiting room.
qs.h: 看第一篇估價單表格下方的說明文字。
qs.trans: 估價單中提到了什麼？
qs.e: 第一篇最後一句說「A deposit of 25 percent of the total is required before work begins.」，開工前須先付 25% 訂金，也就是須預付部分款項，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 估價單有效期限是 30 天（valid for 30 days）；(C) 地板是 vinyl plank（塑膠木紋地板），不是實木；(D) 更換燈具的是兩間診療室（two treatment rooms），候診室是換地板與粉刷。

qs.q: What will most likely be the cost of the revised project before any additional charges?
qs.h: 第二篇說要刪掉哪一個項目？回第一篇用總額扣掉該項目的費用。
qs.trans: 在加收任何額外費用之前，修改後的工程費用最可能是多少？
qs.e: 第二篇 Dr. Montoya 決定保留現有接待櫃檯，「please remove that item from the project」；第一篇顯示新接待櫃檯為 $4,200，總額 $11,550 − $4,200 = $7,350，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) $4,200 是被刪除的接待櫃檯項目費用；(C) $8,452.50 是 $7,350 再加 15% 夜間週末附加費後的金額，題目問的是加價之前；(D) $11,550 是原始估價總額。

qs.q: Why does Dr. Montoya want to keep the current reception counter?
o: She plans to buy one from another company.
Her partners designed it themselves.
It was recently repaired.
It is still fairly new.
qs.h: 看第二篇第一段 since 後面的理由。
qs.trans: Montoya 醫師為什麼想保留目前的接待櫃檯？
qs.e: 第二篇第一段說「We have decided to keep our current reception counter, since it was installed only four years ago」，櫃檯四年前才裝，還算新，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 文中沒有提到要向其他公司購買；(B) 合夥人只是一起看估價單，沒有說櫃檯是他們設計的；(C) 文中沒有提到櫃檯曾經修理。

qs.q: What is suggested about the renovation project?
o: It will be completed before May 2.
It will include a new reception counter.
Its cost will be increased by 15 percent.
It will require the office to close on Saturdays.
qs.h: 第二篇、第三篇說施工安排在什麼時段？回第一篇查在這些時段施工要怎麼收費。
qs.trans: 關於這項裝修工程，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第一篇說「Work can be scheduled on evenings and weekends for an additional charge of 15 percent」；第二篇 Dr. Montoya 要求在營業時間外施工「even with the added cost」，第三篇也確認施工只在平日晚上與週末進行，因此工程費用會加收 15%，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 5 月 2 日是開工日，不是完工日；(B) 接待櫃檯已被刪除；(D) 施工安排在週六下午，而診所週六本來就下午 1:00 結束營業，不需要因此關閉。

qs.q: What is suggested about some of the dental office's staff members?
o: They normally work past 6:00 P.M.
They will help the crew paint the hallway.
They will work on Sundays during the project.
They will move patient files to another building.
qs.h: 看第三篇第二段最後一句 staff members who usually ...。
qs.trans: 關於診所的部分員工，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第三篇第二段說「staff members who usually stay late to finish paperwork should plan to leave by 6:00 P.M. while the project is under way」，可推知有些員工平常會待到晚上 6:00 以後，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 員工只需清空個人物品，粉刷是施工團隊的工作；(C) 診所週日休診，員工不會上班；(D) 病歷是鎖在診所內的病歷室，沒有搬到其他建築。

qs.q: What is indicated about the workshops on the Web page?
o: They are all taught by the same instructor.
They charge full-time employees a fee.
They each last a full day.
They are held in the same room.
qs.h: 看第一篇第一句關於地點的說明。
qs.trans: 關於網頁上的工作坊，文中提到了什麼？
qs.e: 第一篇第一句說「All workshops take place in Training Room B」，所有工作坊都在同一間教室舉行，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 講師有 Ingrid Paulsen、Marcel Okonkwo、Lionel Quarshie 三位；(B) 全職員工免費參加（free for full-time employees）；(C) 只有 7 月 15 日的資料視覺化是全天，其餘都是三小時。

qs.q: What is NOT mentioned on the Web page?
o: A limit on how many workshops employees may attend
A deadline for registering for a workshop
A certificate for employees who complete a workshop
Meals provided at certain sessions
qs.h: NOT 題：逐一核對第一篇最後一段的說明。
qs.trans: 下列何者「沒有」在網頁上被提到？
qs.e: 第一篇完全沒有提到完成工作坊後會發給證書，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 「employees may attend up to two workshops per quarter」；(B) 「Registration for each workshop closes five business days before it begins」；(D) 「Lunch is provided at full-day workshops」。

qs.q: Why does Mr. Matsuda need his manager's approval?
o: He has requested more than two workshops.
He does not work full-time.
He belongs to a different department from the instructors.
He has asked for a special meal.
qs.h: 第三篇只說需要主管核准；回第一篇找出哪一類員工參加需經主管核准，再對照第二篇報名表上他的資料。
qs.trans: Matsuda 先生為什麼需要主管核准？
qs.e: 第二篇報名表顯示他的「Employment status: Part-time」，而第一篇規定「Part-time employees may attend with their manager's approval」，因此他身為兼職員工才需要主管 Ms. Lambert 核准，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 他只報名兩場，沒有超過每季兩場的上限；(C) 文中沒有規定跨部門需要核准；(D) 素食需求已轉告外燴廠商，與主管核准無關。

qs.q: What does Ms. Nolan say she has done?
o: Forwarded a meal request to a food provider
Reserved a laptop for Mr. Matsuda
Received approval from Ms. Lambert
Changed the date of a workshop
qs.h: 看第三篇第二段第一句 I have ...。
qs.trans: Nolan 女士說她已經做了什麼？
qs.e: 第三篇第二段說「I have noted your meal request and passed it on to the caterer」，她已把素食需求轉告外燴廠商，caterer 即 food provider，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 借筆電需要 Mr. Matsuda 自己向 IT 部門申請；(C) 她還在等 Ms. Lambert 回覆核准；(D) 文中沒有更改任何工作坊日期。

qs.q: What is indicated about Ms. Paulsen?
o: She leads the negotiation workshop.
She will lend laptops to participants.
She manages the Structural Design department.
She has asked for questions to be submitted before July 18.
qs.h: 第三篇提到「the instructor for both of your workshops」，先從第二篇找出他報名的兩場，再回第一篇看講師是誰。
qs.trans: 關於 Paulsen 女士，文中提到了什麼？
qs.e: 第二篇顯示他報名 Writing Clear Technical Reports 與 Introduction to Data Visualization，第一篇這兩場的講師都是 Ingrid Paulsen；第三篇說這位講師「has asked participants to send any questions about the course materials before July 18」，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 談判技巧工作坊的講師是 Lionel Quarshie；(B) 借筆電的是 IT 部門；(C) 第二篇顯示 Mr. Matsuda 的主管是 Odette Lambert，文中沒有說 Ms. Paulsen 管理結構設計部。

qs.q: What is stated about the study in the e-mail?
o: It will be conducted online.
It is open to people of all ages.
Participants will share their views in a group discussion.
Each session lasts two hours.
qs.h: 看第一篇第一段最後一句，參與者試喝之後要做什麼？
qs.trans: 電子郵件中提到了這項研究的什麼？
qs.e: 第一篇第一段說參與者「will sample several drinks and then discuss their opinions in a small group led by one of our moderators」，會在小組中討論意見，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 只有之前的問卷是線上填寫，試飲在 Lamont 街的研究中心舉行；(B) 研究只開放給成年人（open only to adults）；(D) 每場 90 分鐘，不是兩小時。

qs.q: What is suggested about Mr. Ishida in the e-mail?
o: He regularly drinks tea or coffee.
He works for a beverage company.
He has taken part in a taste test before.
He lives near Lamont Street.
qs.h: 他是依問卷答案被選上的，再看第一篇最後一段研究對參加者的限制。
qs.trans: 關於 Ishida 先生，電子郵件中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第一篇說他是根據問卷答案「have been selected」，而最後一段說「the study is open only to adults who regularly drink tea or coffee」，既然他獲選，可推知他經常喝茶或咖啡，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 文中沒有提到他的工作；(C) 沒有提到他以前參加過試飲；(D) Lamont 街是研究中心的地址，沒有說他住在附近。

qs.q: To which age group does Mr. Ishida most likely belong?
o: 55 and over
Under 18
qs.h: 第三篇寫他參加哪一天的場次？回第二篇查那一場是哪個年齡組。
qs.trans: Ishida 先生最可能屬於哪一個年齡組別？
qs.e: 第三篇顯示他參加「Saturday, November 22」的場次，第二篇中 11 月 22 日是 Session 4，對象為「Ages 35–54」，且第二篇規定「Participants may attend only the session for their age group」，因此他屬於 35 到 54 歲組，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 18–34 歲組是 11 月 18 日上午的 Session 1；(C) 55 歲以上組是 11 月 20 日的 Session 3；(D) 第一篇說研究只開放給成年人（open only to adults），且沒有未滿 18 歲的場次。

qs.q: What does Mr. Ishida indicate about the planned price of the product?
o: It is lower than that of similar drinks.
It should include a discount for frequent buyers.
It is reasonable for the size of the can.
It is more than he would be willing to pay.
qs.h: 看第三篇第 3 題他對 $3.50 的回答。
qs.trans: 關於這項產品的預定售價，Ishida 先生表示了什麼？
qs.e: 第三篇第 3 題他回答「It is somewhat high. I would pay up to $2.75.」，他最多只願意付 2.75 美元，低於預定的 3.50 美元，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 他沒有和類似飲品比較價格；(B) 他只說大概每週會買一次，沒有要求常客折扣；(C) 他認為價格有點高，並不覺得合理。

qs.q: How much did Mr. Ishida most likely receive in total for taking part in the study?
qs.h: 第一篇說明兩種酬勞的條件；再對照第三篇的參加日期與問卷提交日期，看他是否在一週內交回。
qs.trans: Ishida 先生參加這項研究總共最可能獲得多少錢？
qs.e: 第一篇說參加者活動結束可得 $75 禮物卡，「within one week of their session」完成後續問卷再得 $25。第三篇顯示他 11 月 22 日參加、11 月 27 日提交問卷，相隔五天，在一週之內，因此共得 $75 + $25 = $100，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) $25 只是後續問卷的額外酬勞；(B) $75 是只參加活動、未在期限內交問卷的金額；(D) $150 沒有任何依據。

passages.head: Appliance Retailers to Combine
passages.text:
RIVERTON (May 12) — Two of the region's best-known home appliance retailers will soon operate under a single name. Talmadge Home Appliances announced on Monday that it has agreed to merge with Sawyer & Reese Electronics in a deal expected to be completed by the end of September. [1]

Talmadge, founded in 1978, runs fourteen stores across the state and is known mainly for its kitchen appliances. Sawyer & Reese, which has nine locations, focuses on televisions and home audio equipment. The combined company will be called Talmadge Reese and will be based in Riverton. [2]

Company leaders say the merger will allow the business to purchase products from manufacturers in larger quantities and pass the savings on to shoppers. [3] "Our customers have told us they want one place to buy everything for their homes," said Talmadge president Rhonda Underwood. "Together, we can offer a much wider selection."

Not everyone is convinced the plan will benefit employees. Retail analyst Simon Yearwood pointed out that six Talmadge stores are located within two miles of a Sawyer & Reese store. "Some of those locations will almost certainly close," he said. Ms. Underwood stated that no decisions about closures have been made. [4] She added that workers at any store that closes would be offered positions at nearby locations.

Shoppers should not expect immediate changes. Both chains will continue to honor existing warranties and gift cards, and new store signs are not expected to appear until early next year.
passages.trans:
家電零售商將合併

RIVERTON（5 月 12 日）——本地區兩家最知名的家電零售商即將以同一個名稱營運。Talmadge 家電於星期一宣布，已同意與 Sawyer & Reese 電子合併，這項交易預計於 9 月底前完成。[1]

成立於 1978 年的 Talmadge 在全州經營十四家門市，主要以廚房家電聞名。擁有九個據點的 Sawyer & Reese 則專攻電視和家庭音響設備。合併後的公司將名為 Talmadge Reese，總部設在 Riverton。[2]

公司高層表示，合併後公司能向製造商大量採購，並將省下的成本回饋給消費者。[3]「顧客告訴我們，他們希望能在同一個地方買齊家中所需的一切，」Talmadge 總裁 Rhonda Underwood 表示，「攜手合作後，我們能提供更豐富的商品選擇。」

並非所有人都相信這項計畫對員工有利。零售分析師 Simon Yearwood 指出，有六家 Talmadge 門市與 Sawyer & Reese 的門市相距不到兩英里。「其中有些門市幾乎肯定會關閉，」他說。Underwood 女士表示，目前尚未對關店做出任何決定。[4] 她補充說，任何關閉門市的員工都將獲得到附近門市任職的機會。

消費者短期內不會感受到變化。兩家連鎖店將繼續受理現有的保固與禮品卡，新的店面招牌預計要到明年初才會出現。

奧勒岡州 Salem 市 Tremont 大道 310 號 6 室，郵遞區號 97301

10 月 2 日

Ulrich Rasmussen 先生
Rasmussen 五金行
Quarry 路 57 號
奧勒岡州 Salem 市，郵遞區號 97302

親愛的 Rasmussen 先生：

謹代表 Westhaven 識字基金會全體同仁，再次感謝您慷慨捐贈 500 美元給今年春季的「一起閱讀」活動。在像您這樣的支持者協助下，我們送出超過 3,000 本免費書籍給本地小學的孩童，並培訓了 45 位新的志工閱讀家教。

我寫這封信是要邀請您參加我們年度最大型的募款活動——Westhaven 書展暨拍賣會。活動將於 11 月 14 日星期六在 Tremont 社區會館舉行。本地作家將為自己的最新著作簽名，來賓也可以競標由地方商家捐贈的物品，包括餐廳禮券、週末飯店住宿和手工家具。所有收益將用於在 Willow 街開設一間免費的課後閱讀中心。

貴店是否願意考慮捐贈一件物品供拍賣會使用？捐贈價值 200 美元以上物品的商家，將被列名於活動手冊及我們網站的贊助商名單上。若您願意參與，請填寫隨信附上的捐贈表格，並於 10 月 30 日前寄回。物品可送至我們的辦公室；若是較大型的物品，我們也可安排前往收取。

活動門票成人每張 25 美元，未滿十二歲的孩童免費入場。為感謝您過去的支持，我已隨信附上兩張招待券。

如有任何問題，請致電 (555) 012-6640 與我聯絡。

Theresa Wolcott 敬上
活動總監
