passages.head:
Media Contact: Yolanda Reyes, yreyes@sundaleoutfitters.com
Release date: August 18
passages.text:
SACRAMENTO, CA — Sundale Outfitters, a family-owned retailer of camping and hiking equipment, will open its fifth store on September 6 at the Riverbend Plaza shopping center in Sacramento. At 18,000 square feet, the new store will be the company's largest. It will be open from 9:00 A.M. to 9:00 P.M. every day. [1]

The new location will feature an indoor climbing wall where customers can try out shoes and harnesses before buying them, as well as a repair center for bicycles and camping stoves. [2] Sundale will also offer free weekend workshops, led by experienced local guides, on topics such as trail navigation and backcountry cooking.

"Many of our customers in this area have been driving more than two hours to visit our Fresno store," said company founder Wesley Ramsey. "We're excited to finally bring Sundale closer to them." [3]

To celebrate the opening, the first 200 shoppers on September 6 will receive a free reusable water bottle, and all tents and sleeping bags will be 25 percent off through September 14. The store will also host a gear swap on September 13, when shoppers can trade in their used equipment for store credit. [4]

Sundale Outfitters was founded in Fresno in 1994. Its other stores are located in Fresno, Bakersfield, Visalia, and Modesto, California. The new Sacramento location has hired 45 employees, most of whom live nearby. For more information, visit www.sundaleoutfitters.com.
passages.trans:
媒體聯絡人：Yolanda Reyes，yreyes@sundaleoutfitters.com
發布日期：8 月 18 日

加州沙加緬度——家族經營的露營與健行裝備零售商 Sundale Outfitters 將於 9 月 6 日在沙加緬度的 Riverbend Plaza 購物中心開設第五家門市。新店面積達 18,000 平方英尺，將是該公司規模最大的門市。營業時間為每天上午 9:00 至晚上 9:00。[1]

新門市將設有室內攀岩牆，顧客可在購買前試穿攀岩鞋和吊帶；店內另設有自行車與露營爐具的維修中心。[2] Sundale 還將在週末舉辦由經驗豐富的在地嚮導帶領的免費工作坊，主題包括步道導航與野外烹飪。

「這一帶有許多顧客一直都要開兩個多小時的車到我們的 Fresno 門市，」公司創辦人 Wesley Ramsey 表示，「我們很高興終於能把 Sundale 帶到離他們更近的地方。」[3]

為慶祝開幕，9 月 6 日前 200 名顧客將獲贈一個免費的環保水瓶，所有帳篷與睡袋在 9 月 14 日前一律 75 折。門市也將於 9 月 13 日舉辦裝備交換活動，顧客可將二手裝備折抵為商店購物金。[4]

Sundale Outfitters 於 1994 年在 Fresno 創立。其他門市位於加州的 Fresno、Bakersfield、Visalia 和 Modesto。沙加緬度新門市已聘用 45 名員工，其中大多數住在附近。欲知詳情，請上 www.sundaleoutfitters.com。

docs.head: Ravenna Interiors — Design Help for Every Budget
docs.text:
Whether you're furnishing your first apartment or updating an entire office, the designers at Ravenna Interiors can help you create a space you'll love.

• Room Refresh ($150): A two-hour visit in which a designer suggests furniture arrangements, paint colors, and lighting for one room.
• Full Room Design ($600): A complete design plan for one room, including a 3-D drawing, a detailed shopping list, and two rounds of revisions.
• Whole-Home Package ($1,800): Full design plans for up to four rooms, plus a designer on site on delivery day to oversee furniture placement.

Clients who purchase furniture from our showroom on Tallow Street receive 10 percent off every piece they buy. Consultations are available Monday through Saturday. Call (555) 019-3302 or book online at www.ravennainteriors.com.

docs.head:
To: info@ravennainteriors.com
From: Xavier Underhill <x.underhill@quickmail.com>
Date: January 14
Subject: Design services
docs.text:
Hello,

I recently purchased a condominium on Sutter Avenue and will be moving in on February 20. I'm bringing the bedroom and kitchen furniture from my current apartment, so I only need help with the living room, which is quite large and has an unusual shape.

Rather than having someone simply give me suggestions during a short visit, I'd like a detailed plan that I can follow on my own, including drawings and a list of items to buy. If I like the design, I will probably purchase the sofa and coffee table from your showroom.

Also, since I work long hours during the week, I would appreciate it if the designer's first visit could be scheduled on a Saturday.

Best regards,
Xavier Underhill

passages.trans:
【第一篇：廣告】
Ravenna 室內設計——任何預算都能獲得設計協助

無論您是要布置人生第一間公寓，還是要翻新整間辦公室，Ravenna 室內設計的設計師都能協助您打造一個您會愛上的空間。

• 房間煥新（150 美元）：兩小時的到府服務，由設計師針對一個房間建議家具擺設、油漆顏色和照明。
• 完整房間設計（600 美元）：一個房間的完整設計方案，包括 3D 圖、詳細購物清單及兩次修改。
• 全屋方案（1,800 美元）：最多四個房間的完整設計方案，外加家具送達當天由設計師到場監督擺放。

在我們位於 Tallow 街的展示間購買家具的客戶，每件家具皆可享 9 折優惠。諮詢服務時間為星期一至星期六。請致電 (555) 019-3302 或上 www.ravennainteriors.com 線上預約。

【第二篇：電子郵件】
收件者：info@ravennainteriors.com
寄件者：Xavier Underhill <x.underhill@quickmail.com>
日期：1 月 14 日
主旨：設計服務

您好：

我最近在 Sutter 大道買了一間公寓，將於 2 月 20 日入住。我會把目前公寓裡的臥室和廚房家具搬過去，所以我只需要客廳的設計協助，客廳相當大，而且形狀不太規則。

比起請人在短暫的到府拜訪中單純給我一些建議，我更希望有一份我能自己照著執行的詳細方案，包括圖面和採購清單。如果我喜歡這份設計，我很可能會在貴公司的展示間購買沙發和茶几。

另外，由於我平日工作時間很長，若設計師的第一次拜訪能安排在星期六，我會非常感激。

敬祝 安好
Xavier Underhill

docs.head: Yarrow Bay Tours — Summer Day Trips
docs.text:
Lighthouse & Seafood Tour — $85 per person
Visit the historic Point Rowan Lighthouse, then enjoy a three-course seafood lunch in the fishing village of Tern Harbor. Departs Tuesdays and Thursdays.

Island Kayak Adventure — $110 per person
Paddle through calm channels with an experienced guide and explore two uninhabited islands. Lunch is not included. Departs Wednesdays and Saturdays. Participants must be at least 14 years old.

Wine Country Excursion — $125 per person
Tour three family-run vineyards and sample their wines. Includes lunch at Vireo Vineyard. Departs Fridays and Sundays. Participants must be 21 or older.

All tours leave at 8:30 A.M. from our office at 12 Wharf Street and return by 5:00 P.M. Groups of six or more save 10 percent. Bookings canceled at least 48 hours in advance receive a full refund.

From: Silas Thornquist <sthornquist@yarrowbaytours.com>
Date: July 15
Subject: Your July 17 tour
docs.text:
Dear Ms. Whitcombe,

Thank you for booking with Yarrow Bay Tours. Unfortunately, the restaurant in Tern Harbor where we normally serve lunch will be closed on July 17 for kitchen repairs. On that day, lunch will instead be served at the Wavecrest Grill, which is located a short walk from the lighthouse. I have already told the Wavecrest staff about the allergy mentioned in your request, and the chef will prepare a separate meal for that member of your group.

Because we will not be stopping in Tern Harbor, we would like to offer you a refund of $15 per participant. Alternatively, you may move your booking to Tuesday, July 22, when the full tour will run as usual. Please let me know which option you prefer by noon tomorrow.

To answer your other question, free parking is available behind our Wharf Street office.

Sincerely,
Silas Thornquist
Customer Care, Yarrow Bay Tours

docs.head: Tidewater Film Festival Moves to Larger Home
docs.text:
SAVANNAH (August 30) — The Tidewater Film Festival will celebrate its tenth year from October 9 to 12 with more than 60 films from 18 countries. Organizers expect the event to draw about 8,000 visitors. For the first time, most screenings will take place at the newly renovated Rialto Theater on Whitaker Street, which seats 650 people. Short-film programs will be shown at the smaller Sable Hall, two blocks away.

"The Rialto gives us room to grow," said festival director Simone Vasquez. "In past years, many of our screenings sold out within hours."

Festival passes, which allow entry to all screenings, cost $95 and go on sale September 15. Tickets for individual films are $12 and will be available starting October 1. Volunteers who work at least two four-hour shifts receive a free festival pass.

docs.head:
To: Tidewater Film Festival Volunteers
From: Simone Vasquez
Date: October 14
Subject: Thank you!
docs.text:
Dear volunteers,

Thank you for helping to make this year's festival our most successful ever. A total of 9,500 people attended, well above our expectations. Thanks in large part to your efforts, every screening at the Rialto started on time.

I'm also pleased to share that this year's Audience Award went to Salt and Stone, a documentary about a family of oyster farmers. The film will be shown again free of charge at Sable Hall on November 2 at 7:00 P.M., and all of you are invited.

Finally, please complete our short online survey by October 24. Your suggestions will help us plan next year's festival.

Simone Vasquez
Festival Director

docs.head: Tidewater Film Festival — Reviewed by Wanda Sorensen, October 16
docs.text:
This was my third time attending the Tidewater Film Festival, and the move to the Rialto was a big improvement. The seats are comfortable, and the sound system is excellent. Because I worked two shifts at the information desk, I received a free pass and was able to see eleven films.

My only complaint concerns the short-film programs. The venue two blocks from the Rialto was so small that I was turned away from two sold-out programs. I hope the organizers will find a larger space for them next year.

The highlight for me was a documentary about oyster farmers that I saw at the Rialto on the festival's final day. I was not at all surprised to learn afterward that it had won an award.

passages.trans:
【第一篇：文章】
Tidewater 影展遷往更大的新場地

薩凡納（8 月 30 日）——Tidewater 影展將於 10 月 9 日至 12 日歡度第十屆，屆時將放映來自 18 個國家、超過 60 部電影。主辦單位預計活動將吸引約 8,000 名觀眾。大部分的放映場次將首度在 Whitaker 街剛整修完成、可容納 650 人的 Rialto 戲院舉行。短片單元則在兩個街區外較小的 Sable 廳放映。

「Rialto 讓我們有成長的空間，」影展總監 Simone Vasquez 表示，「過去幾年，我們有許多場次在幾小時內就售罄。」

可進場觀賞所有場次的影展通行證售價 95 美元，9 月 15 日開賣。單場電影票每張 12 美元，10 月 1 日起開始販售。擔任至少兩班、每班四小時的志工，可獲得一張免費影展通行證。

【第二篇：電子郵件】
收件者：Tidewater 影展志工們
寄件者：Simone Vasquez
日期：10 月 14 日
主旨：謝謝大家！

親愛的志工們：

感謝各位協助讓今年的影展成為我們有史以來最成功的一屆。總計有 9,500 人參加，遠超出我們的預期。很大程度上多虧了各位的努力，Rialto 的每一場放映都準時開始。

我也很高興與大家分享，今年的觀眾票選獎由《Salt and Stone》獲得，這是一部關於一個養蠔家族的紀錄片。這部片將於 11 月 2 日晚上 7:00 在 Sable 廳免費加映，誠摯邀請各位參加。

最後，請在 10 月 24 日前填寫我們簡短的線上問卷。您的建議將幫助我們規劃明年的影展。

Simone Vasquez
影展總監

【第三篇：評論】
Tidewater 影展——評論者 Wanda Sorensen，10 月 16 日

這是我第三次參加 Tidewater 影展，搬到 Rialto 是一大進步。座椅很舒適，音響系統也非常棒。因為我在服務台值了兩班，我拿到一張免費通行證，看了十一部電影。

我唯一的不滿是關於短片單元。距離 Rialto 兩個街區的那個場地太小了，有兩個場次因為客滿，我被拒於門外。我希望主辦單位明年能為短片單元找個更大的場地。

對我來說最精彩的是影展最後一天在 Rialto 看的一部關於養蠔人家的紀錄片。後來得知它得了獎，我一點也不意外。

qs.q: What does Mr. Salas indicate about the stump grinder?
o: It needs to be repaired.
It was rented for Thursday.
It was left at another location.
It is too large for the truck.
qs.h: 看 8:46 A.M. Ramon Salas 如何回答 Tessa「有沒有帶研磨機」的問題。
qs.trans: Salas 先生提到樹樁研磨機的什麼情況？
qs.e: Tessa 問「Do you have the stump grinder with you?」，Ramon 在 8:46 A.M. 回答「we left it back at the equipment yard」，也就是機器被留在設備場、不在施工現場，(C)「被留在另一個地點」正是此意的改寫，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 文中沒有提到機器故障需要維修；(B) 星期四是 Tessa 提議回來施工的日子，並未提到租用機器；(D) 文中沒有提到機器太大放不進卡車。

qs.q: At 8:53 A.M., what does Ms. Yoder most likely mean when she writes, "Not a chance"?
o: The patio will not be damaged.
The crew is not available on Thursday.
Mr. Ruston will not receive a price quote.
The stump cannot be removed.
qs.h: 對照前一則（8:51 A.M.）Ramon 轉述客戶擔心什麼，再看 Tessa 這句話後面補充的說明。
qs.trans: 在上午 8:53，Yoder 女士寫「Not a chance」最有可能是什麼意思？
qs.e: 8:51 A.M. Ramon 說客戶擔心「grinding the stump might crack his patio stones」（磨樹樁會弄裂露臺石板），Tessa 回「Not a chance」（絕不可能），並補充「The crew always lays protective boards over the stones first」，表示露臺不會受損，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) Tessa 自己提議星期四回去施工，並非星期四沒空；(C) 她在 8:49 A.M. 說下午會寄報價單；(D) 樹樁只是今天不移除，星期四可以處理。

qs.q: What is available only to Dedicated Desk members?
o: Free beverages
Use of a meeting room
Printing services
A mail-handling service
qs.h: 比較「All members enjoy...」與「Dedicated Desk members may also...」兩句，找出只有專屬座位會員才有的服務。
qs.trans: 什麼服務只提供給專屬座位會員？
qs.e: 廣告提到「Dedicated Desk members may also use our street address as their business address and have their mail received and held at the front desk」，只有專屬座位會員可由櫃檯代收郵件，(D)「郵件處理服務」為其改寫，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A)(C) 免費咖啡、茶與列印服務是「All members」都能享有的；(B) 會議室使用時數包含在彈性會員方案中，並非專屬座位會員獨有。

qs.q: How can new members receive a discount?
o: By touring the facility on a weekday
By signing up before a certain date
By paying for a full year in advance
By referring a colleague
qs.h: 看廣告最後一段關於「first week free」的條件。
qs.trans: 新會員要如何獲得優惠？
qs.e: 最後一段寫「Sign up for any monthly membership before May 31 and get your first week free」，在 5 月 31 日前申辦即可享第一週免費，(B)「在特定日期前申辦」為其改寫，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 平日導覽只是參觀時段，並非取得優惠的條件；(C) 文中沒有提到預付一整年；(D) 文中沒有推薦同事的優惠。

qs.q: How must customers use the coupon?
o: By entering a code on a Web site
By registering in person
By booking a private group event
By showing a student ID card
qs.h: 看 Terms and conditions 第二點：優惠券要在哪裡、什麼時候出示？
qs.trans: 顧客必須如何使用這張優惠券？
qs.e: 條款第二點寫「Must be presented at our front desk at the time of registration. Online bookings are not eligible.」，必須在櫃檯報名時出示，也就是親自到場報名，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 線上預約不適用此優惠；(C) 私人團體活動明確排除在外；(D) 優惠券不得與學生優惠合併，並未要求出示學生證。

qs.q: What is NOT indicated about the classes?
o: Ingredients are supplied.
Participants receive recipes.
Some are held on weekends.
They are limited to ten participants.
qs.h: 逐一核對選項：食材、食譜卡、週末課程分別在哪裡出現？哪一項完全沒提到？
qs.trans: 關於這些課程，何者未被提及？
qs.e: 文中提到「All ingredients and aprons are provided」、「Participants take home printed recipe cards」，且優惠適用於「Saturday or Sunday class」，但完全沒有提到每班人數上限為十人，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 對應「All ingredients and aprons are provided」；(B) 對應「take home printed recipe cards」；(C) 對應「one Saturday or Sunday class」。

qs.q: Why was no shipping fee charged?
o: The order total was above a certain amount.
The clinic is a long-time customer.
One of the items was shipped late.
The clinic picked up the items itself.
qs.h: 看 Shipping 那一行括號內的說明。
qs.trans: 為什麼沒有收取運費？
qs.e: 發票上「Shipping: $0.00 (free shipping on all orders over $1,000)」，而本訂單小計為 1,061 美元，超過 1,000 美元的門檻，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 發票沒有提到診所是長期客戶；(C) 耳鏡組延後出貨是因為缺貨，與免運無關；(D) 商品是寄出的（were shipped），並非診所自取。

qs.q: What is suggested about the otoscope set?
o: It is the least expensive item on the invoice.
It cannot be returned.
It will arrive after the other items.
It was shipped on February 3.
qs.h: 看 Note 中耳鏡組與「其他品項」的出貨日期有何不同。
qs.trans: 關於耳鏡組，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 備註寫耳鏡組「is currently on back order and will be shipped separately by February 17」，而「All other items were shipped on February 3」，可推知耳鏡組會比其他品項晚到，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 耳鏡組單價 395 美元，是最貴的品項；(B) 未使用的設備 30 天內都可退貨；(D) 2 月 3 日出貨的是其他品項，耳鏡組另行寄出。

qs.q: Why did Ms. Varga send the e-mail?
o: To process a claim that Mr. Ziegler filed
To recommend a security company
To announce that a policy has been canceled
To give a client details about renewing a policy
qs.h: 看主旨與第一段：保單即將怎樣、她請收件人做什麼？
qs.trans: Varga 女士為什麼寄這封電子郵件？
qs.e: 主旨為「Your policy renewal」，第一段提到保單「is set to expire on May 1」並請對方審閱「the attached renewal terms」，後文再說明保費與保障內容的變動，目的在向客戶說明續約細節，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 信中明言保費調漲「is not related to any claim you have filed」，並非處理理賠；(B) 只提到安裝警報系統可享折扣，沒有推薦特定保全公司；(C) 保單是即將到期、要續約，並未被取消。

qs.q: According to the e-mail, how can Mr. Ziegler reduce his premium?
o: By returning the form before April 22
By showing evidence of an alarm system
By filing fewer claims
By paying the full amount in advance
qs.h: 第二段「However, you can lower your cost by...」之後說明了降低保費的方法與條件。
qs.trans: 根據電子郵件，Ziegler 先生要如何降低保費？
qs.e: 第二段指出「you can lower your cost by installing a monitored alarm system. Policyholders who provide proof of such a system receive a 10 percent discount」，提供警報系統的證明即可享折扣，proof 對應 evidence，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 4 月 22 日是寄回續約表格的期限，與折扣無關；(C) 保費調漲與理賠無關，也沒有提到少理賠可降價；(D) 信中沒有提到預付全額的優惠。

qs.q: What is indicated about the renewed policy?
o: It covers a type of damage that the previous policy did not.
It requires the installation of an alarm system.
It will take effect on April 22.
It costs less than the current policy.
qs.h: 看第三段「In addition, your renewed policy will now include...」。
qs.trans: 關於續約後的保單，文中提到什麼？
qs.e: 第三段說續約保單「will now include protection against damage caused by water leaks... which was excluded from your previous policy」，新增了舊保單不保的漏水損害，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 安裝警報系統只是可享折扣的選項，並非必要條件；(C) 4 月 22 日是寄回表格的期限，舊保單 5 月 1 日才到期；(D) 保費由 1,840 美元調漲到 1,960 美元，比原本貴。

qs.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
o: To advertise a new line of smartphones
To explain the cause of a network outage
To announce a change to customers' service plans
To ask customers to update their contact information
qs.h: 看標題與第一段第一、二句：哪個方案要停止？用戶會被轉到哪裡？
qs.trans: 這則公告的目的為何？
qs.e: 第一段開頭寫「Velora Mobile will retire its Basic Talk & Text plan. Customers currently on this plan will be moved automatically to our Essential plan」，目的是通知用戶其資費方案即將變更，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 替換手機只是針對 3G 手機用戶的配套措施，並非推銷新手機系列；(B) 文中沒有提到網路中斷；(D) 公告明言「No action is required」，也沒有要求更新聯絡資料。

qs.q: According to the notice, what will happen after the first twelve months on the Essential plan?
o: Customers must sign a new contract.
The monthly charge will go up.
The data allowance will be reduced.
A termination fee will be charged.
qs.h: 看第一段最後兩句關於月費的說明。
qs.trans: 根據公告，使用 Essential 方案滿十二個月後會發生什麼事？
qs.e: 第一段指出前十二個月月費維持 30 美元，「After that, the standard Essential rate of $35 per month will apply」，月費會由 30 美元變成 35 美元，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 文中沒有提到要重新簽約；(C) 數據量每月 5 GB，沒有提到會減少；(D) 只說 6 月 30 日前解約免付提前解約金，並未說滿十二個月後要收解約金。

qs.q: What is suggested about customers who have 3G-only phones?
o: They must pay an early termination fee.
They will be allowed to keep the Basic Talk & Text plan.
They are required to call customer care by June 30.
Their current phones will not work on the Essential plan.
qs.h: 看第二段「However, ...」那一句說明 Essential 方案在哪些網路上運作。
qs.trans: 關於持有僅支援 3G 手機的用戶，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第二段寫「the Essential plan operates only on our 4G and 5G networks, so phones that support only 3G service cannot be used with it」，可知這些用戶現有的手機在新方案下無法使用，因此才提供免費替換手機，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 6 月 30 日前解約不收提前解約金，且文中未針對 3G 用戶收費；(B) Basic Talk & Text 方案將全面停止，所有用戶都會被轉移；(C) 他們需要的是 6 月 15 日前到門市換機，並非 6 月 30 日前打電話給客服。

qs.q: What problem does Ms. Szabo mention?
o: Many customers are sending back a product.
A supplier has raised its prices.
A jacket is no longer in stock.
Shipping times have become longer.
qs.h: 看 2:05 P.M. Wendy 開場提到的數據。
qs.trans: Szabo 女士提到了什麼問題？
qs.e: Wendy 在 2:05 P.M. 說「the return rate for our Trailside rain jacket jumped to 18 percent last month」，雨衣退貨率大增，代表很多顧客把商品退回，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 對話只提到換了新工廠，沒有提到供應商漲價；(C) 沒有提到缺貨；(D) 只提到每次換貨的運費約 9 美元，沒有提到運送時間變長。

qs.q: At 2:11 P.M., what does Mr. Thakkar most likely mean when he writes, "I'm on it"?
o: He has already finished updating the site.
He is currently viewing the product page.
He will take care of a task right away.
He is waiting for information from the factory.
qs.h: 對照 2:10 P.M. Wendy 請 Raj 做什麼，再看 Raj 接著說「I'll also...」。
qs.trans: 在下午 2:11，Thakkar 先生寫「I'm on it」最有可能是什麼意思？
qs.e: 2:10 P.M. Wendy 問「Raj, can you get the correct measurements on the site today?」，Raj 回答「I'm on it」（我馬上處理），並接著說還會加上建議選大一號的說明，表示他會立刻著手更新尺寸資訊，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 他才剛答應要做，接著還說「I'll also add...」，表示工作尚未完成；(B) 這是利用 on 的字面意思設下的陷阱，並非「正在瀏覽頁面」；(D) 正確尺寸他已知道（窄約兩公分），沒有提到在等工廠資料。

qs.q: What will Ms. Ruiz's team most likely do next?
o: Correct the size chart on the Web site
Contact customers who recently purchased the jacket
Negotiate a new contract with the factory
Stop offering free exchanges
qs.h: 看 2:13 P.M. Selena 說她會請團隊做什麼。
qs.trans: Ruiz 女士的團隊接下來最有可能做什麼？
qs.e: Selena 在 2:13 P.M. 說「I'll have my team send a short e-mail to everyone who bought the jacket in the past two weeks」，她的團隊會寄信給近期購買者，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 更新網站尺寸表是 Raj 負責的工作；(C) 對話中沒有提到與工廠重新協商；(D) 她的團隊反而會附上預付換貨標籤，繼續協助換貨。

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
o: The opening of a new appliance store
The closure of several retail locations
A change in a company's leadership
An agreement between two retailers to combine
qs.h: 看標題與第一段：兩家公司宣布了什麼？
qs.trans: 這篇文章主要是關於什麼？
qs.e: 標題「Appliance Retailers to Combine」，第一段寫 Talmadge「has agreed to merge with Sawyer & Reese Electronics」，全文圍繞兩家零售商合併一事，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 文中沒有提到開設新門市；(B) 關店只是分析師的推測，且總裁表示尚未做出決定，並非文章主旨；(C) 文中沒有提到人事異動。

qs.q: What is indicated about Sawyer & Reese Electronics?
o: It specializes in home entertainment products.
It was founded in 1978.
It has more stores than Talmadge Home Appliances.
It has decided to close six of its stores.
qs.h: 看第二段介紹 Sawyer & Reese 的那一句。
qs.trans: 關於 Sawyer & Reese 電子，文中提到什麼？
qs.e: 第二段寫 Sawyer & Reese「focuses on televisions and home audio equipment」，電視與家庭音響即家庭娛樂產品，(A) 為其改寫，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 1978 年成立的是 Talmadge；(C) Sawyer & Reese 只有九家，Talmadge 有十四家；(D) 文中是六家「Talmadge」門市鄰近對方門市，而且尚未決定關店。

qs.q: In the article, the word "honor" in paragraph 5 is closest in meaning to
o: celebrate
accept
reward
admire
qs.h: 看 honor 的受詞是什麼（existing warranties and gift cards），想想對保固與禮品卡會「做」什麼。
qs.trans: 在文章中，第五段的「honor」一字意思最接近下列何者？
qs.e: 第五段「Both chains will continue to honor existing warranties and gift cards」，honor 的受詞是保固與禮品卡，此處指「承認、接受並履行」，也就是消費者仍可照常使用，與 accept 意思最接近，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) celebrate 是「慶祝、表揚」；(C) reward 是「獎賞」；(D) admire 是「欽佩」，皆為 honor 作「尊敬、表揚」時的意思，不適用於保固與禮品卡。

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Such discounts are expected to be greatest on large items such as refrigerators and televisions."
qs.h: 句首的「Such discounts」指的是前文提到的某種省錢效果，找出哪一句講到把省下的成本回饋給顧客。
qs.trans: 下列句子最適合放在標示 [1]、[2]、[3]、[4] 的哪個位置？「這類折扣預計在冰箱和電視等大型商品上最為明顯。」
qs.e: 插入句以「Such discounts」開頭，必須緊接在提到降價的句子之後。第三段的「pass the savings on to shoppers」（把省下的成本回饋給消費者）正是這類折扣，放在其後的 [3] 語意最連貫，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) [1] 前面只講合併交易與完成時間，尚未提到任何折扣；(B) [2] 前面在介紹兩家公司的規模與合併後名稱；(D) [4] 前後談的是門市關閉與員工安置，與折扣無關。

qs.q: Why did Ms. Wolcott write to Mr. Rasmussen?
o: To ask him to volunteer as a reading tutor
To confirm that a book order has been shipped
To request a donation for a fundraising event
To announce the opening of a reading center
qs.h: 找「I am writing to...」那一句，再看第三段開頭她問對方什麼。
qs.trans: Wolcott 女士為什麼寫信給 Rasmussen 先生？
qs.e: 第二段寫「I am writing to invite you to take part in our largest fundraising event」，第三段接著問「Would your store consider donating an item for the auction?」，寫信目的是請對方為募款拍賣會捐贈物品，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 志工閱讀家教只是說明先前活動的成果，沒有邀請他擔任；(B) 信中沒有任何訂書或出貨的內容；(D) 閱讀中心是募款要用於開設的目標，尚未開幕。

qs.q: What is suggested about Mr. Rasmussen?
o: He has given money to the foundation before.
He is a local author.
He has agreed to attend the event on November 14.
He owns a furniture store.
qs.h: 看第一段 Wolcott 女士為什麼向他道謝，以及第四段為何送他招待券。
qs.trans: 關於 Rasmussen 先生，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第一段感謝他「your generous gift of $500 to last spring's Read Together campaign」，第四段也提到「As a thank-you for your past support」，可知他過去曾捐款給該基金會，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 簽書的是「Local authors」，信中沒有說他是作家；(C) 信是邀請他參加，他尚未答應；(D) 他經營的是 Rasmussen Hardware（五金行），手工家具只是拍賣品之一。

qs.q: What is NOT mentioned as an item that will be auctioned?
o: Meals at restaurants
Hotel accommodations
Handmade furniture
Concert tickets
qs.h: 看第二段「including...」列出的拍賣品，逐一比對。
qs.trans: 下列何者未被提及為拍賣品？
qs.e: 第二段列出的拍賣品為「restaurant gift certificates, weekend hotel stays, and handmade furniture」，信中沒有提到音樂會門票（信中的 tickets 是書展活動的入場券），故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 對應「restaurant gift certificates」；(B) 對應「weekend hotel stays」；(C) 對應「handmade furniture」。

qs.q: What has Ms. Wolcott included with the letter?
o: A list of event sponsors
Free admission to an event
A copy of the event program
A receipt for a past donation
qs.h: 找信中「enclosed」出現的地方，看隨信附上了哪些東西。
qs.trans: Wolcott 女士隨信附上了什麼？
qs.e: 第四段寫「I have enclosed two complimentary tickets with this letter」，complimentary tickets（招待券）即免費入場，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 贊助商名單會刊登在活動手冊與網站上，並未附在信中；(C) 信中沒有附上活動手冊；(D) 信中沒有提到附上捐款收據。

qs.q: What is the purpose of the press release?
o: To announce the opening of a new store
To introduce a new line of camping stoves
To celebrate a company's anniversary
To recruit instructors for workshops
qs.h: 看第一段第一句：Sundale 將在 9 月 6 日做什麼？
qs.trans: 這篇新聞稿的目的為何？
qs.e: 第一段寫 Sundale Outfitters「will open its fifth store on September 6 at the Riverbend Plaza shopping center」，後文介紹新店設施與開幕活動，目的在宣布新門市開幕，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 露營爐具只是維修中心的服務項目，並非推出新產品；(C) 文中只提到 1994 年創立，沒有週年慶活動；(D) 工作坊是免費提供給顧客，並未招募講師。

qs.q: What is suggested about Sundale Outfitters?
o: It was founded in Sacramento.
It has stores outside of California.
It charges a fee for its workshops.
Some of its customers have traveled long distances to shop.
qs.h: 看第三段創辦人 Wesley Ramsey 說的話。
qs.trans: 關於 Sundale Outfitters，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 創辦人表示「Many of our customers in this area have been driving more than two hours to visit our Fresno store」，可知有顧客一直長途開車去購物，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 最後一段寫該公司「was founded in Fresno」；(B) 其他門市都位於加州（Fresno、Bakersfield、Visalia、Modesto）；(C) 第二段說工作坊是「free weekend workshops」。

qs.q: In the press release, the word "host" in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to
o: entertain
present
hold
accommodate
qs.h: 看 host 的受詞是什麼（a gear swap），門市對一場「活動」會做什麼？
qs.trans: 在新聞稿中，第四段的「host」一字意思最接近下列何者？
qs.e: 第四段「The store will also host a gear swap on September 13」，host 的受詞是一場裝備交換活動，此處指「舉辦、主辦」，與 hold 意思最接近，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) entertain 是 host 作「招待（客人）」時的意思；(B) present 是 host 作「主持（節目）」時的意思；(D) accommodate 是 host 作「接待、容納（訪客）」時的意思，皆不符合「舉辦活動」的語境。

qs.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Staff members trained in bicycle and stove maintenance will run this area of the store."
qs.h: 插入句提到「bicycle and stove maintenance」和「this area」，找出前文哪裡提到與自行車、爐具相關的店內區域。
qs.trans: 下列句子最適合放在標示 [1]、[2]、[3]、[4] 的哪個位置？「受過自行車與爐具保養訓練的員工將負責店內的這個區域。」
qs.e: 插入句的「this area」必須指前文剛提到的某個店內區域，且與自行車、爐具維修有關。第二段的「a repair center for bicycles and camping stoves」正是這個區域，放在其後的 [2] 最合適，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) [1] 前面只介紹新店地點與面積，尚未提到任何區域；(C) [3] 前面是創辦人談顧客長途開車的引述；(D) [4] 前面在講開幕優惠與裝備交換活動，與維修區無關。

qs.q: What is indicated about the workshops?
o: They are held online.
They include a midday meal.
Each one is led by a different facilitator.
They last half a day.
qs.h: 看第一篇時程表下方的說明段落，以及講師欄位。
qs.trans: 關於這些工作坊，文中提到什麼？
qs.e: 第一篇說明「All workshops run from 9:00 A.M. to 4:00 P.M. and include lunch and printed course materials」，工作坊包含午餐，lunch 即 a midday meal，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 工作坊在 Upton 商務中心舉行，不是線上課程；(C) Tobias Wren 負責 3 月 11 日與 3 月 25 日兩場；(D) 上午 9:00 到下午 4:00 是一整天，不是半天。

qs.q: Which workshop does Ms. Ruelas want Mr. Yu to attend instead?
o: Leading Remote Teams
Giving Effective Feedback
Budget Planning for Managers
Negotiation Fundamentals
qs.h: 第二篇她說要轉到「Mr. Wren's other workshop later this month」，再到第一篇找 Wren 先生的另一場課。
qs.trans: Ruelas 女士希望 Yu 先生改參加哪一場工作坊？
qs.e: 第二篇寫她想把報名轉到「Mr. Wren's other workshop later this month」。對照第一篇，Tobias Wren 除了 3 月 11 日的 Giving Effective Feedback 之外，只負責 3 月 25 日的「Negotiation Fundamentals」，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) Leading Remote Teams 的講師是 Renata Szymanski；(B) Giving Effective Feedback 是 Yu 先生原本報名、無法參加的 3 月 11 日課程；(C) Budget Planning for Managers 的講師是 Ursula Thorne。

qs.q: Why will Mr. Yu be unable to attend the workshop on March 11?
o: He will be away on a business trip.
He has to lead a training session.
He will be on vacation.
He must meet a client at his office.
qs.h: 看第二篇第一段最後一句 Raymond Yu 那一週要做什麼。
qs.trans: 為什麼 Yu 先生無法參加 3 月 11 日的工作坊？
qs.e: 第二篇第一段寫 Raymond Yu「now has to travel to Toronto for a client meeting that week」，他那週要出差去多倫多見客戶，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 文中沒有提到他要主持訓練課程；(C) 他是因公出差，不是休假；(D) 客戶會議在多倫多，需要出差，並非在自己辦公室見客戶。

qs.q: Why is Ms. Ruelas unable to receive a refund for Mr. Yu's registration?
o: She received a group discount.
Refunds are given only to individual registrants.
She made her request less than a week before the workshop.
The workshop has already taken place.
qs.h: 比對第二篇電子郵件的寄信日期與工作坊日期，再看第一篇的退費規定。
qs.trans: 為什麼 Ruelas 女士無法為 Yu 先生的報名取得退費？
qs.e: 第一篇規定「Registrations canceled at least seven days before a workshop are fully refunded」。第二篇電子郵件寄於 3 月 6 日，距離 3 月 11 日的工作坊只剩五天，不足七天，因此無法退費，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 退費規定與是否享有團體折扣無關；(B) 文中沒有此限制；(D) 3 月 11 日的工作坊在寄信當時（3 月 6 日）尚未舉行。

qs.q: What does Ms. Ruelas ask about?
o: Whether lunch will be provided
Whether a price reduction will still be applied
Whether Mr. Yu can attend online
How to pay the difference in price
qs.h: 看第二篇最後一段「could you tell me whether...」。
qs.trans: Ruelas 女士詢問了什麼？
qs.e: 第二篇最後一段問「could you tell me whether the discount we received will still apply to the two remaining registrations?」，她想知道剩下兩筆報名是否仍享有折扣，discount 即 price reduction，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 信中沒有詢問午餐；(C) 她是要把報名轉到另一場工作坊，沒有問線上參加；(D) 她只說明白可能需要補差價（I realize that I may need to pay the difference），並沒有詢問付款方式。

qs.q: What is included only in the Whole-Home Package?
o: Supervision of furniture placement on delivery day
A 3-D drawing of a room
A detailed shopping list
Suggestions for paint colors
qs.h: 比較第一篇三種服務的內容，找出只有全屋方案才有的項目。
qs.trans: 哪一項服務只包含在全屋方案中？
qs.e: 第一篇只有 Whole-Home Package 寫到「plus a designer on site on delivery day to oversee furniture placement」，送貨當天由設計師到場監督家具擺放，oversee 即 supervision，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B)(C) 3D 圖與詳細購物清單在 Full Room Design 中就有提供；(D) 油漆顏色建議是 Room Refresh 的內容。

qs.q: How much will Mr. Underhill most likely pay for design services?
qs.h: 第二篇他需要設計幾個房間？他想要的是單純建議，還是含圖面與採購清單的詳細方案？再對照第一篇的價格。
qs.trans: Underhill 先生最有可能為設計服務支付多少錢？
qs.e: 第二篇他說「I only need help with the living room」，且想要「a detailed plan... including drawings and a list of items to buy」。第一篇中提供單一房間 3D 圖與詳細購物清單的是 Full Room Design，價格為 600 美元，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 150 美元的 Room Refresh 只是到府給建議，正是他說不想要的方式（Rather than having someone simply give me suggestions）；(C) 750 美元是把兩種服務相加，他不需要同時購買兩種服務；(D) 1,800 美元的全屋方案涵蓋最多四個房間，他只需要客廳。

qs.q: What is NOT indicated about Mr. Underhill?
o: He will move into a new home next month.
He works long hours on weekdays.
He plans to keep some of his current furniture.
He has used Ravenna Interiors' services in the past.
qs.h: 逐一核對第二篇的入住日期、工作時間、家具安排；哪一項信中完全沒提？
qs.trans: 關於 Underhill 先生，下列何者未被提及？
qs.e: 第二篇中，他從未提到過去曾使用過 Ravenna 室內設計的服務，這封信是他首次詢問設計服務，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 信件寄於 1 月 14 日，他將於 2 月 20 日入住，正是下個月；(B) 對應「I work long hours during the week」；(C) 對應「I'm bringing the bedroom and kitchen furniture from my current apartment」。

qs.q: What will Mr. Underhill receive if he buys the sofa he mentions?
o: Free delivery
A price reduction
An additional design revision
A free home visit
qs.h: 第二篇他打算在哪裡買沙發？再看第一篇對在該處購買家具的客戶有什麼優惠。
qs.trans: 如果 Underhill 先生購買他提到的沙發，他會得到什麼？
qs.e: 第二篇提到他「will probably purchase the sofa and coffee table from your showroom」，第一篇則說「Clients who purchase furniture from our showroom on Tallow Street receive 10 percent off every piece」，因此他買沙發可享 9 折，即價格折扣，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 廣告沒有提到免運送費；(C) 兩次修改已包含在 Full Room Design 中，並非購買家具的優惠；(D) 廣告沒有提到購買家具可獲贈免費到府服務。

qs.q: What does Mr. Underhill request?
o: A design for his bedroom
A 3-D drawing of his kitchen
An appointment on a weekend day
A discount on the Whole-Home Package
qs.h: 看第二篇最後一段「I would appreciate it if...」。
qs.trans: Underhill 先生提出了什麼請求？
qs.e: 第二篇最後一段寫「I would appreciate it if the designer's first visit could be scheduled on a Saturday」，他希望約在星期六，也就是週末的某一天，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A)(B) 他說臥室與廚房家具會沿用舊的，只需要客廳的設計；(D) 他沒有要全屋方案，也沒有要求折扣。

qs.q: According to the Web page, what is true about all of the tours?
o: They include lunch.
They have a minimum age requirement.
They operate every day of the week.
They depart from the same place.
qs.h: 看第一篇最後一段「All tours...」那一句。
qs.trans: 根據網頁，關於所有行程何者正確？
qs.e: 第一篇最後一段寫「All tours leave at 8:30 A.M. from our office at 12 Wharf Street」，所有行程都從同一個辦公室出發，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 島嶼獨木舟探險「Lunch is not included」；(B) 燈塔與海鮮之旅沒有年齡限制；(C) 三個行程分別在週二四、週三六、週五日出發，星期一沒有行程。

qs.q: Why most likely did Ms. Whitcombe's group not receive a discount?
o: It has fewer than six members.
It booked less than 48 hours in advance.
It chose a tour that departs on a weekday.
It did not enter a promotional code.
qs.h: 看第二篇表格中的預約資訊與扣款金額，再對照第一篇提到的優惠條件。
qs.trans: Whitcombe 女士的團體最可能為什麼沒有獲得折扣？
qs.e: 第一篇規定「Groups of six or more save 10 percent」，第二篇表格顯示參加人數為「4 adults」，總額 340 美元正好是 85 美元 × 4 的原價，未達六人門檻，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 48 小時是取消可全額退費的規定，與折扣無關；(C) 網頁沒有提到平日出發會影響折扣；(D) 文中沒有提到任何優惠代碼。

qs.q: What problem does Mr. Thornquist mention?
o: A tour guide is not available.
A restaurant will be temporarily closed.
A tour bus needs repairs.
The lighthouse will not be open to visitors.
qs.h: 看第三篇第一段「Unfortunately, ...」那一句。
qs.trans: Thornquist 先生提到了什麼問題？
qs.e: 第三篇第一段寫「the restaurant in Tern Harbor where we normally serve lunch will be closed on July 17 for kitchen repairs」，平常用餐的餐廳當天暫停營業，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 信中沒有提到導遊無法出團；(C) 需要整修的是餐廳廚房，不是遊覽車；(D) 午餐改在燈塔附近的餐廳，燈塔參觀照常進行。

qs.q: How much will Ms. Whitcombe receive if she chooses the refund?
qs.h: 第三篇提到每位參加者退多少錢？再看第二篇表格的參加人數。
qs.trans: 如果 Whitcombe 女士選擇退款，她會收到多少錢？
qs.e: 第三篇提供「a refund of $15 per participant」，第二篇表格顯示「Number of participants: 4 adults」，因此退款總額為 15 × 4 = 60 美元，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 15 美元只是每人的退款金額；(B) 34 美元是 340 美元的 10%，與團體折扣比例混淆；(D) 85 美元是此行程每人的原價。

qs.q: What is suggested about the Wavecrest Grill?
o: It is able to prepare a meal that meets a dietary need.
It is located in Tern Harbor.
It will be closed for repairs on July 17.
It is owned by Yarrow Bay Tours.
qs.h: 看第三篇第一段 Thornquist 先生已經告知 Wavecrest 員工什麼事，以及主廚會怎麼做。
qs.trans: 關於 Wavecrest Grill，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第三篇提到他已告知 Wavecrest 員工過敏的情況，且「the chef will prepare a separate meal for that member of your group」，可知這家餐廳能為有飲食限制（甲殼類過敏）的客人準備適合的餐點，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 它位於燈塔附近，而且信中說這次「will not be stopping in Tern Harbor」；(C) 7 月 17 日因整修休息的是 Tern Harbor 的餐廳；(D) 文中沒有提到它屬於 Yarrow Bay 旅遊。

qs.q: According to the article, what is new about this year's festival?
o: It is being held for the first time.
Ticket prices have been lowered.
Short films will be screened at the Rialto Theater.
Most films will be shown at a different venue than before.
qs.h: 在第一篇第一段找「For the first time」這個關鍵片語。
qs.trans: 根據文章，今年的影展有什麼新的變化？
qs.e: 第一篇寫「For the first time, most screenings will take place at the newly renovated Rialto Theater」，今年首度把大部分場次移到 Rialto 戲院，代表放映場地改變了，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 今年是「its tenth year」第十屆，並非首次舉辦；(B) 文中沒有提到票價調降；(C) 短片單元是在 Sable Hall 放映，不是 Rialto。

qs.q: What is indicated about the festival's attendance?
o: It was lower than in the previous year.
It was limited to 650 people per day.
It was about 1,500 people higher than organizers had predicted.
It included visitors from 18 countries.
qs.h: 比較第一篇主辦單位的預估人數與第二篇公布的實際參加人數。
qs.trans: 關於影展的參加人數，文中提到什麼？
qs.e: 第一篇寫「Organizers expect the event to draw about 8,000 visitors」，第二篇則說「A total of 9,500 people attended」，9,500 − 8,000 = 1,500，實際人數比預估多出約 1,500 人，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 文中沒有提到去年人數，且 Vasquez 女士說今年是「most successful ever」；(B) 650 是 Rialto 戲院的座位數，不是每日人數上限；(D) 18 個國家指的是電影的來源國，並非觀眾。

qs.q: What is most likely true about Ms. Sorensen?
o: She works at the Rialto Theater.
She received Ms. Vasquez's e-mail.
She attended the festival for the first time.
She saw fewer than ten films.
qs.h: 第三篇她在影展期間做了什麼？再看第二篇的電子郵件是寄給哪些人。
qs.trans: 關於 Sorensen 女士，何者最有可能為真？
qs.e: 第三篇她說「I worked two shifts at the information desk, I received a free pass」，可知她是影展志工；第二篇電子郵件的收件者正是「Tidewater Film Festival Volunteers」，因此她最有可能收到了 Vasquez 女士的信，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 她是在影展服務台擔任志工，沒有提到她在 Rialto 戲院工作；(C) 她說「This was my third time attending」；(D) 她看了 eleven films（十一部）。

qs.q: In the article, the word "draw" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
o: attract
sketch
remove
tie
qs.h: 看 draw 的受詞是「about 8,000 visitors」，活動對觀眾會產生什麼作用？
qs.trans: 在文章中，第一段的「draw」一字意思最接近下列何者？
qs.e: 第一段「Organizers expect the event to draw about 8,000 visitors」，draw 的受詞是觀眾，此處指「吸引」人潮，與 attract 意思最接近，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) sketch 是 draw 作「畫圖、素描」時的意思；(C) remove 是 draw 作「抽出、拔出」時的意思；(D) tie 是 draw 作「（比賽）打成平手」時的意思，皆不符合語境。

qs.q: What is suggested about the documentary that Ms. Sorensen praised?
o: It was shown only at Sable Hall.
It was directed by Ms. Vasquez.
It received an award from film critics.
It will be shown again in November.
qs.h: 第三篇她最喜歡的是哪一部片？到第二篇找這部片得了什麼獎、之後有什麼安排。
qs.trans: 關於 Sorensen 女士稱讚的那部紀錄片，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第三篇她稱讚「a documentary about oyster farmers」並說它得了獎；第二篇指出得到觀眾票選獎的《Salt and Stone》正是「a documentary about a family of oyster farmers」，且「will be shown again free of charge at Sable Hall on November 2」，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 她是在 Rialto 看這部片的，並非只在 Sable Hall 放映；(B) Vasquez 女士是影展總監，文中沒有說她執導此片；(C) 這部片得的是「Audience Award」（觀眾票選獎），不是影評人頒的獎。

qs.q: According to the Web page, what is true about vouchers?
o: They can be used to purchase gift cards.
They can be exchanged for cash.
They can be used only for a limited time.
They are available only to Chapter Club members.
qs.h: 看第一篇最後一段「Please note: ...」的第一句。
qs.trans: 根據網頁，關於抵用券何者正確？
qs.e: 第一篇最後一段寫「Reward and birthday vouchers expire 90 days after they are issued」，抵用券發放 90 天後失效，只能在有限期間內使用，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 網頁只說購買禮品卡不累積點數，沒有說抵用券可以買禮品卡；(B) 網頁沒有提到抵用券可兌換現金；(D) 三個等級的會員都可以累積點數兌換抵用券，也都有生日抵用券。

qs.q: Why did Ms. Tavares receive fewer points than she expected?
o: One of her purchases was not eligible for points.
She paid part of her total with a voucher.
Her membership level had recently changed.
She made her purchase online.
qs.h: 看第二篇收據上她買了哪些東西，再對照第一篇最後一段哪一類商品不累積點數。
qs.trans: 為什麼 Tavares 女士獲得的點數比她預期的少？
qs.e: 第一篇規定「Points are not earned on gift card purchases」，而第二篇收據顯示她買了一張 50 美元的禮品卡。扣除禮品卡後，兩本書共 28 + 42 = 70 美元，70 × 1.5 = 105 點，與收據上的點數完全吻合，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (B) 若點數是以扣掉抵用券後的金額計算，點數不會剛好是 105；實際上 105 點正是兩本書 70 美元 × 1.5 的結果，與抵用券無關；(C) 收據與電子郵件都顯示她仍是 Page Turner 會員；(D) 她是在 Sycamore Square 門市購買的。

qs.q: What is suggested about the items Ms. Tavares bought on March 8?
o: They were all hardcover books.
Some of them were intended as presents.
They were ordered through the Web site.
They were paid for with a gift card.
qs.h: 看第二篇收據上有一項免費服務，想想這項服務通常用在什麼情況。
qs.trans: 關於 Tavares 女士 3 月 8 日購買的商品，文中暗示了什麼？
qs.e: 第二篇收據列有「Gift wrapping (2 items) — $0.00」，她請店家為兩件商品做禮品包裝，可推知其中有些商品是要送人的禮物，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 只有《The Silent Orchard》標示為精裝本，另外還有一張禮品卡；(C) 收據來自 Sycamore Square 實體門市；(D) 她是「購買」了一張禮品卡，付款方式是簽帳金融卡（debit card）。

qs.q: Which membership level does Ms. Tavares hope to reach?
o: Bookworm
Page Turner
Gold Reader
Chapter Club
qs.h: 第三篇她目前是什麼等級？她想升到「下一個等級」以免付運費，再到第一篇找哪個等級提供這項福利。
qs.trans: Tavares 女士希望升到哪一個會員等級？
qs.e: 第三篇她說自己是 Page Turner 會員，希望「stop paying for delivery」並「reach the next level this year」。第一篇中比 Page Turner 高一級、且提供「free shipping on all online orders」的是 Chapter Club，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) Bookworm 是最低等級；(B) Page Turner 是她目前的等級；(C) 網頁上沒有 Gold Reader 這個等級。

qs.q: What is NOT a benefit that Ms. Tavares currently receives as a member?
o: Free gift wrapping
A birthday voucher
Free delivery of online orders
1.5 points for each dollar spent
qs.h: 先從第二篇或第三篇確認她目前的會員等級，再到第一篇看該等級有哪些福利。
qs.trans: 下列何者不是 Tavares 女士目前身為會員所享有的福利？
qs.e: 她目前是 Page Turner 會員。第一篇中 Page Turner 享有 1.5 倍點數、免費禮品包裝與 10 美元生日抵用券，但免運費只有 Chapter Club 才有，且網頁註明 Page Turner 會員線上訂單須付 6 美元運費，她在第三篇也說想「stop paying for delivery」，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) 收據上禮品包裝為 0 元，符合 Page Turner 的「free gift wrapping」；(B) 她使用了 10 美元的生日抵用券；(D) Page Turner 每消費 1 美元得 1.5 點。

exams.title: Part 7 Practice: Double Passages
exams.sub: 2 組雙篇閱讀 × 5 題（題號 176–185）．比對兩份文件之間的條件、日期與金額

docs.kind: 第一篇：維修工單 Service Report
docs.head: Borealis Commercial HVAC — Field Service Report #SR-519
docs.text:
Service Date: July 22 | Technician: Marco Bellini
Client: FreshMart Supermarket (Branch #14 — Elmwood Ave.)
Equipment: Walk-In Dairy Cooler (Model: PolarMax 800)

Inspection Findings:
Arrived at 9:15 A.M. in response to an urgent call from store manager Kendra Shaw regarding rising temperatures inside the walk-in dairy cooler (measured at 9°C; normal operating range is 1°C–4°C).

1. Condenser Coils: Heavily coated with dust and debris, restricting airflow. Cleaned thoroughly on-site.
2. Door Gasket: Rubber seal along the bottom edge of the main door is torn, allowing warm air to leak into the unit. Replaced with a new PolarMax seal from service van inventory.
3. Evaporator Fan Motor: Bearing is worn out and making a loud grinding noise. The motor is still running at reduced speed but must be replaced soon to prevent complete failure. Because the specific motor (Part #PM-44B) is out of stock locally, I have ordered it directly from the manufacturer.

Follow-Up Required:
Part #PM-44B is scheduled to arrive at our warehouse on July 27. A follow-up visit has been booked for July 28 at 8:00 A.M. to install the new motor.

docs.kind: 第二篇：內部電子郵件 E-mail
docs.head:
To: Regional Operations <ops@freshmartgrocers.com>
From: Kendra Shaw <kshaw@freshmartgrocers.com>
Date: July 22, 2:30 P.M.
Subject: Dairy Cooler Repair at Branch #14
docs.text:
Hi everyone,

I wanted to update you on the refrigeration issue at the Elmwood Avenue store this morning. When our morning shift arrived at 7:00 A.M., the walk-in dairy cooler alarm was sounding. We immediately moved all milk, yogurt, and cheese crates into the backup meat-and-produce chiller, so no inventory was spoiled.

Borealis HVAC sent a technician out within two hours. Cleaning the coils and replacing a damaged door seal brought the cooler temperature back down to 3°C by noon, and we have moved the dairy products back in.

However, the technician noted that one internal component is worn and needs a replacement part that won't arrive until next week. Once he returns on July 28 to install that part, I will ask him to inspect our frozen-food display cases as well, since they haven't had their annual maintenance check yet.

Best,
Kendra Shaw
Store Manager, Branch #14

passages.trans:
【第一篇：維修工單】
Borealis 商用空調冷凍公司 — 現場維修報告 #SR-519
維修日期：7 月 22 日｜技師：Marco Bellini
客戶：FreshMart 超市（第 14 分店 — Elmwood 大道）
設備：步入式乳製品冷藏庫（型號：PolarMax 800）
檢查結果：
接獲店長 Kendra Shaw 關於步入式乳製品冷藏庫溫度上升的緊急叫修後，於上午 9:15 抵達（實測溫度為 9°C；正常運轉範圍為 1°C–4°C）。
1. 冷凝器盤管：覆蓋厚重灰塵與碎屑，阻礙氣流。已於現場徹底清潔。
2. 門框膠條：主門下緣橡膠封條破損，導致熱空氣滲入機組。已取用維修車庫存之全新 PolarMax 封條更換完畢。
3. 蒸發器風扇馬達：軸承磨損並發出巨大刺耳摩擦聲。馬達目前仍以較低轉速運轉，但必須儘快更換以免完全故障。由於該特定馬達（零件編號 #PM-44B）當地缺貨，我已直接向原廠訂購。
後續處理：零件 #PM-44B 預計 7 月 27 日抵達本倉庫，已預約 7 月 28 日上午 8:00 再次到場安裝新馬達。

收件人：區域營運部｜寄件人：Kendra Shaw｜日期：7 月 22 日下午 2:30｜主旨：第 14 分店乳製品冷藏庫維修
各位好：想向各位報告今天早上 Elmwood 大道門市冷藏設備異常的處理狀況。早班人員 7:00 到店時，步入式乳製品冷藏庫的警報正在作響。我們立即將所有牛奶、優格與起司籃移至備用的肉品蔬果冷藏室，因此沒有任何庫存報廢。Borealis 公司在兩小時內就派技師到場。清潔盤管並更換破損門封後，冷藏庫溫度在中午已降回 3°C，我們也已將乳製品移回。不過技師指出有一個內部零件磨損，替換零件要下週才會到貨。等他 7 月 28 日回來安裝該零件時，我會請他順便檢查我們的冷凍食品展示櫃，因為今年還沒做年度保養檢查。

docs.text:
All workshops meet once a week for 8 weeks from 6:30 P.M. to 8:30 P.M. Materials are included in the tuition fee unless noted otherwise.

• Watercolor Landscapes (Mondays, Studio 2)
  Instructor: Helene Vance | Tuition: $180
  Designed for beginners; learn color mixing, brushwork, and perspective.

• Wheel-Thrown Pottery (Tuesdays, Ceramics Lab)
  Instructor: Kenji Sato | Tuition: $240
  Create bowls, mugs, and vases on the potter's wheel. Includes clay and kiln firing.

• Digital Travel Photography (Wednesdays, Media Room B)
  Instructor: Lucas Meyer | Tuition: $195
  Master manual camera settings, lighting, and photo editing. Participants must bring their own DSLR or mirrorless camera.

• Artisan Sourdough Baking (Thursdays, Teaching Kitchen)
  Instructor: Chef Marie Laurent | Tuition: $210
  Learn fermentation, shaping, and crust scoring. Take home a fresh loaf each week!

docs.kind: 第二篇：學員評價 Online Review
docs.head: Posted by: Clara Jenkins ★★★★★ (November 28)
docs.text:
I just finished my eight-week autumn workshop at the Oakwood Community Arts Center, and it exceeded all my expectations! Although I had owned a mirrorless camera for two years, I had only ever used it on automatic mode. Our instructor was incredibly patient and explained aperture, shutter speed, and night-sky composition in a way that was easy to understand.

Because I live on Maple Street right here in Oakwood AND signed up on September 15, I saved a nice amount on the registration cost. My only minor suggestion for the center is to add a few more computers with editing software in the classroom, as students occasionally had to share workstations during the second hour of class. Still, I loved the experience so much that I plan to sign up for Kenji Sato's class in the winter term!

張貼者：Clara Jenkins ★★★★★（11 月 28 日）
我剛在 Oakwood 社區藝術中心完成為期八週的秋季工作坊，課程完全超越我的期待！雖然我買無反光鏡相機已經兩年了，但以前都只會用自動模式。我們的講師非常有耐心，用淺顯易懂的方式講解光圈、快門速度與夜空構圖。因為我就住在 Oakwood 的 Maple 街，而且在 9 月 15 日就報名了，我省下了一筆可觀的報名費用。我對中心唯一的小建議是在教室裡多加幾台裝有修圖軟體的電腦，因為在課堂第二個小時，學員偶爾必須共用工作站。儘管如此，我非常喜歡這次的體驗，打算冬季班再去報名佐藤健司老師的課！

qs.q: Why did Kendra Shaw call Borealis Commercial HVAC on the morning of July 22?
o: An annual maintenance inspection was due.
The backup meat chiller was making a loud noise.
The walk-in dairy cooler was too warm.
The frozen-food display cases had stopped working.
qs.h: 查看第一篇 Inspection Findings 第一段（rising temperatures inside the walk-in dairy cooler）。
qs.trans: Kendra Shaw 為何在 7 月 22 日早上致電 Borealis 商用空調冷凍公司？
qs.e: 第一篇指出店長緊急叫修是因為步入式乳製品冷藏庫溫度升高至 9°C（正常應為 1°C–4°C），第二篇也提到早班發現乳製品冷藏庫警報作響，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (D)(A) 冷凍食品展示櫃的年度保養是她打算 7 月 28 日順便請技師做的；(B) 發出刺耳摩擦聲的是乳製品冷藏庫的蒸發器風扇馬達，備用肉品冷藏室運作正常。

qs.q: How did FreshMart staff prevent the dairy products from spoiling?
o: They packed the crates in dry ice.
They transferred the products to another refrigerated unit.
They sold the milk and yogurt at a 50% discount.
They sent the inventory to Branch #15.
qs.h: 查看第二篇第一段第三句「We immediately moved all milk, yogurt, and cheese crates into...」。
qs.trans: FreshMart 員工如何防止乳製品變質報廢？
qs.e: 第二篇第一段說明「We immediately moved all milk, yogurt, and cheese crates into the backup meat-and-produce chiller, so no inventory was spoiled」，即立刻將乳製品移至另一台備用冷藏室，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 未提乾冰；(C) 未提打折出售；(D) 未提移轉至其他分店。

qs.q: What part did Marco Bellini replace on July 22?
o: The rubber door seal
The evaporator fan motor
The condenser coils
The digital temperature alarm
qs.h: 比對第一篇的 1、2、3 點與第二篇第二段：哪一項是在 7 月 22 日當天更換（Replaced）的？
qs.trans: Marco Bellini 在 7 月 22 日當天更換了哪個零件？
qs.e: 第一篇第 2 點寫道「Door Gasket: ... Replaced with a new PolarMax seal from service van inventory」，第二篇也確認「replacing a damaged door seal」，當天更換的是橡膠門封膠條，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (C) 冷凝器盤管是現場清潔（Cleaned thoroughly），並非更換；(B) 蒸發器風扇馬達（Part #PM-44B）缺貨已向原廠訂購，要 7 月 28 日才安裝；(D) 溫度警報器並未損壞或更換。

qs.q: What is Part #PM-44B?
o: A frozen-food display light
A condenser filter
A rubber door gasket
An evaporator fan motor
qs.h: 查看第一篇第 3 點括號內的 Part #PM-44B。
qs.trans: 零件編號 #PM-44B 是什麼？
qs.e: 第一篇第 3 點「Evaporator Fan Motor」說明「Because the specific motor (Part #PM-44B) is out of stock locally, I have ordered it directly from the manufacturer」，故 #PM-44B 為蒸發器風扇馬達，選 (D)。
qs.w: (C) 門封膠條當天已從維修車庫存更換；(B)(A) 非該零件編號所指。

qs.q: What does Ms. Shaw plan to request during the July 28 visit?
o: An inspection of the store's frozen-food cases
Training for staff on cleaning condenser coils
A refund on the initial service call
A price quote for a brand-new walk-in cooler
qs.h: 查看第二篇最後一句「Once he returns on July 28... I will ask him to...」。
qs.trans: Shaw 女士打算在 7 月 28 日技師到訪時要求什麼？
qs.e: 第二篇最後一句明言「Once he returns on July 28 to install that part, I will ask him to inspect our frozen-food display cases as well」，她會請技師順便檢查冷凍食品展示櫃，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (C)(B)(D) 文中均未提及。

qs.q: Who taught the autumn workshop that Clara Jenkins attended?
o: Kenji Sato
Marie Laurent
Helene Vance
Lucas Meyer
qs.h: 在第二篇找出 Clara Jenkins 上課使用的器材與學習內容（mirrorless camera、aperture、shutter speed），再對照第一篇是哪一門課的講師。
qs.trans: Clara Jenkins 參加的秋季工作坊是由誰授課的？
qs.e: 第二篇中 Clara 提到自己帶無反光鏡相機（mirrorless camera），學習光圈、快門速度與修圖軟體，對應第一篇週三的「Digital Travel Photography」，授課講師為 Lucas Meyer，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (C) Helene Vance 教水彩風景畫；(A) Kenji Sato 教手拉坯陶藝（Clara 打算冬季班才去報名他的課）；(B) Marie Laurent 教酸種麵包烘焙。

qs.q: On which day of the week did Clara Jenkins attend her autumn class?
o: Monday
Wednesday
Tuesday
Thursday
qs.h: 對照第一篇 Digital Travel Photography 的上課星期。
qs.trans: Clara Jenkins 在秋季班每週幾去上課？
qs.e: 她參加的 Digital Travel Photography 在第一篇簡章標示為「(Wednesdays, Media Room B)」，即每週三上課，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 週一是水彩課；(C) 週二是陶藝課；(D) 週四是烘焙課。

qs.q: How much did Clara Jenkins pay in total for her autumn workshop?
qs.h: 攝影課學費 $195，她是 Oakwood 居民享 9 折（10% off），且在 9 月 15 日報名免收 $25 報名費：$195 × 0.9 = ?
qs.trans: Clara Jenkins 為她的秋季工作坊總共支付了多少費用？
qs.e: 第一篇顯示數位旅遊攝影學費為 $195。第二篇 Clara 提到自己住在 Oakwood（享學費 9 折：$195 × 0.9 = $175.50），且於 9 月 15 日報名（早於 9 月 20 日早鳥期限，免收 $25 行政報名費），因此總共支付 $175.50，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) $195.00 是未打折的學費；(B) $200.50 是打了 9 折卻誤加上 $25 報名費；(D) $220.00 是原價 $195 加上 $25 報名費。

qs.q: Which room does Clara Jenkins suggest improving?
o: Studio 2
The Ceramics Lab
Media Room B
The Teaching Kitchen
qs.h: 她在第二篇建議在她的上課教室多加幾台電腦，對照第一篇攝影課在哪間教室上課？
qs.trans: Clara Jenkins 建議改善哪一間教室？
qs.e: Clara 在第二篇建議在她的攝影課教室增加裝有修圖軟體的電腦，而第一篇明載數位旅遊攝影的上課地點為「Media Room B」，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (A) Studio 2 是水彩教室；(B) Ceramics Lab 是陶藝教室；(D) Teaching Kitchen 是烘焙廚房。

qs.q: What activity does Clara Jenkins plan to try in the winter term?
o: Baking sourdough bread
Making ceramic items
Painting landscapes
Editing travel videos
qs.h: 查看第二篇最後一句「sign up for Kenji Sato's class in the winter term」，再對照第一篇 Kenji Sato 教什麼。
qs.trans: Clara Jenkins 打算在冬季班嘗試什麼活動？
qs.e: 第二篇最後一句說她打算在冬季班報名 Kenji Sato 的課程，對照第一篇，Kenji Sato 教授的是「Wheel-Thrown Pottery（手拉坯陶藝：製作碗、馬克杯與花瓶）」，即製作陶器，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (C) 風景畫是 Helene Vance 的課；(D) 簡章無影片剪輯課；(A) 酸種麵包是 Marie Laurent 主廚的課。

Total ................................ $810.00

Deposit received (September 8): $405.00
Balance due on the day of the event: $405.00

【第一篇：網頁】Riverside 活動館 — 場地與價格。花園廳 40 人：半天 300／全天 500 美元；露台廳 80 人：半天 550／全天 900 美元；大禮堂 200 人：半天 1,200／全天 2,000 美元。半天租借最多四小時。週六、週日預訂加收 20%。影音套組（投影機、布幕、無線麥克風）每場 150 美元。活動前至少 14 天取消可全額退款，但須扣除 50 美元手續費。
【第二篇：電子郵件】Tallis 設計公司行政人員 Kevin Osei，9 月 2 日：公司打算在 10 月 18 日（週六）晚上 6 點到 10 點為 65 位員工舉辦派對，想租一間能容納所有人、但又不會大到顯得空曠的場地。我們也打算播放今年專案的投影片，需要投影機和布幕。能否寄給我合適場地的帳單？
【第三篇：帳單】Riverside 活動館帳單 #R-2291，客戶 Tallis 設計（Kevin Osei），9 月 5 日開立。活動：10 月 18 日（週六）18:00–22:00。露台廳半天 550 美元；週末加價 20% 110 美元；影音套組 150 美元；合計 810 美元。訂金 405 美元已於 9 月 8 日收到；餘額 405 美元於活動當天支付。

passages.en: Questions 196-200 refer to the following itinerary, notice, and e-mail.

qs.q: What is NOT a requirement for the position?
o: Availability on weekends
Knowledge of Spanish
Fluency in English
Experience at a hotel front desk
qs.h: NOT 題：把四個選項逐一和第一篇的 Requirements 對照。
qs.e: 第一篇列出的必要條件是兩年櫃台經驗、葡萄牙語與英語流利、可輪週末班；西班牙語是「a plus but not required」（加分但非必要），故選 (B)。
qs.w: (C)(D)(A) 都列在 Requirements 中。
qs.trans: 下列何者「不是」這個職位的必要條件？

qs.q: What qualification does Ms. Ribeiro have that is NOT mentioned in the advertisement?
o: She has worked at a hotel front desk.
She can work on weekends.
She can speak French.
She speaks Portuguese fluently.
qs.h: 比對第二篇她列出的能力與第一篇廣告的條件，找出廣告沒有提到的那一項。
qs.e: 第二篇她提到自己有不錯的法語能力（working knowledge of French），而第一篇只提到葡萄牙語、英語與西班牙語，完全沒有提到法語，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (B)(D)(A) 都是第一篇廣告列出的條件。
qs.trans: Ribeiro 女士具備的哪一項資格是廣告中「沒有」提到的？

qs.q: Why does Ms. Ribeiro mention May 6 and May 7?
o: She will be away for a training course.
She will start a new job in Madrid.
She wants to visit the hotel before applying.
She will be training new staff at her hotel.
qs.h: 看第二篇第二段她提到這兩天的原因。
qs.e: 第二篇說她 5 月 6、7 日要在馬德里參加訓練課程（attending a training course in Madrid），所以那兩天無法面試，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (D) 她在現職訓練新人，但和這兩天無關；(B) 她是去上課，不是到馬德里上新工作；(C) 文中沒有提到。
qs.trans: Ribeiro 女士為什麼提到 5 月 6 日和 7 日？

qs.q: What can be concluded about Ms. Ribeiro's interview?
o: It has been canceled.
It will take place in Madrid.
It will be conducted by video.
Her request regarding the date was accepted.
qs.h: 比對第二篇她的請求與第三篇的時程表。
qs.e: 第二篇她請求把面試安排在 5 月 8 日；第三篇時程表顯示她的面試在 May 8, 9:30 A.M.，表示她的請求被接受了，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (C) 面試地點是飯店二樓會議室，不是視訊；(B) 面試在里斯本的飯店舉行；(A) 她的名字仍在時程表上。
qs.trans: 關於 Ribeiro 女士的面試，可以得出什麼結論？

qs.q: Who is Carla Mendes?
o: The person who wrote the job advertisement
A manager who will interview the candidates
A receptionist at the Hotel Lumen
A candidate for the position
qs.h: 看第三篇時程表的第一行。
qs.e: 第三篇寫「Interviewer: Carla Mendes, Front Office Manager」，她是負責面試的櫃台經理，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (D) 應試者名單中沒有她；(C) Lumen 飯店是 Ribeiro 女士的現職；(A) 文中沒有說明廣告由誰撰寫。
qs.trans: Carla Mendes 是誰？

qs.q: What is indicated about Riverside Event Hall?
o: It does not allow events to end after 10:00 P.M.
It provides catering for all events.
It offers discounts to groups of more than 50 people.
It charges more for events held on weekends.
qs.h: 逐一核對第一篇的各項規定。
qs.e: 第一篇寫「A 20% surcharge applies to all Saturday and Sunday bookings」，週末預訂要加收 20%，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (B) 文中沒有提到外燴；(C) 沒有提到人數折扣；(A) 沒有提到結束時間的限制。
qs.trans: 關於 Riverside 活動館，文中指出了什麼？

qs.q: On the Web page, the word "less" in the last line is closest in meaning to
o: fewer
smaller
minus
without
qs.h: 把選項代回「a full refund, less a $50 processing fee」，看哪個意思通順。
qs.e: a full refund, less a $50 processing fee 指「全額退款，但要扣掉 50 美元手續費」，這裡的 less 是介系詞「減去」，與 minus 最接近，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (B)(A) smaller、fewer 是比較級形容詞，不能這樣用；(D) without 會變成「不含手續費的全額退款」，意思相反。
qs.trans: 在網頁最後一行中，less 一字的意思最接近下列何者？

qs.q: Why was the Terrace Room most likely selected for Tallis Design?
o: It is the smallest room that can hold all of the employees.
It is the least expensive room for a full-day rental.
It is the only room with audiovisual equipment.
It is available only on Saturdays.
qs.h: 第二篇提到人數與「不要太大」的需求，回第一篇比對各場地容量。
qs.e: 第二篇說有 65 人，希望場地夠大但不要太空曠；第一篇中花園廳只能容納 40 人，露台廳可容納 80 人，大禮堂可容納 200 人。露台廳是能容納所有人的最小場地，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (C) 影音套組是另外加購，每間都可以租；(D) 文中沒有這項限制；(B) 他們租的是半天，而且最便宜的是花園廳。
qs.trans: 露台廳最可能為什麼被選為 Tallis 設計的場地？

qs.q: Why does the invoice include a $110 charge?
o: The party will last more than four hours.
The party will be held on a Saturday.
Mr. Osei asked for extra microphones.
The deposit was paid after the deadline.
qs.h: 第三篇的 $110 是什麼名目？再回第一篇查這筆費用的規定。
qs.e: 第三篇的 $110 是 Weekend surcharge (20%)；第一篇規定週六、週日預訂加收 20%，而派對在週六（$550 × 20% = $110），故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A) 派對 6 點到 10 點，正好四小時，符合半天租借；(C) 麥克風包含在 $150 的影音套組裡；(D) 文中沒有提到逾期付款。
qs.trans: 帳單上為什麼有一筆 110 美元的費用？

qs.q: If Mr. Osei canceled the booking on September 20, how much would he receive back?
qs.h: 先確認 9 月 20 日距離活動有沒有超過 14 天，再看他已經付了多少錢。
qs.e: 9 月 20 日距離 10 月 18 日超過 14 天，依第一篇規定可全額退款但扣除 50 美元手續費。第三篇顯示他目前只付了 405 美元訂金，所以可拿回 $405 − $50 = $355，故選 (A)。
qs.w: (D) $405 是已付的訂金，沒有扣手續費；(C) $760 是總額 $810 扣掉 $50，但他尚未付清總額；(B) $810 是帳單總額。
qs.trans: 如果 Osei 先生在 9 月 20 日取消預訂，他會拿回多少錢？

qs.q: What is Ms. Hart scheduled to do on October 13?
o: Fly back to Boston
Visit Fernwood Supplies' factory
Meet with representatives of Dalton Tech
Attend an industry exhibition
qs.h: 看第一篇 10 月 13 日的行程，注意同義改寫。
qs.e: 第一篇 10 月 13 日的行程是 North American Packaging Expo（全天的包裝博覽會），也就是參加產業展覽，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (C) 與 Dalton Tech 開會是 10 月 12 日；(A) 回程原定 10 月 15 日；(B) 與 Fernwood 開會是 10 月 14 日，而且文中沒有說是參觀工廠。
qs.trans: Hart 女士 10 月 13 日原定要做什麼？

qs.q: Why is the new schedule for Flight NA 208 a problem for Ms. Hart?
o: She would miss the opening of the expo.
She would have to pay an additional fare.
She would arrive after her meeting with Dalton Tech begins.
She would not be able to check in to her hotel.
qs.h: 比對第二篇新的抵達時間與第一篇當天的第一個約會。
qs.e: 第二篇說 NA 208 改為下午 2:25 抵達；第一篇顯示她當天下午 2:00 要與 Dalton Tech 開會。新班機抵達時會議已經開始，所以她在第三篇要求改搭較早班機，故選 (C)。
qs.w: (D) 文中沒有提到入住時間的限制；(A) 博覽會在 10 月 13 日；(B) 改搭 NA 204 不需加價。
qs.trans: NA 208 班機的新時刻為什麼對 Hart 女士造成問題？

qs.q: What does Northair offer to passengers on Flight NA 208?
o: A discount on a future flight
A free change to a different flight
An upgrade to a higher class of service
A hotel room in Toronto
qs.h: 看第二篇第二段航空公司提供的選擇。
qs.e: 第二篇說乘客可以改搭 NA 204「at no additional cost」（不需額外費用），也就是免費改搭其他班機，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (A)(D)(C) 文中都沒有提到；另一個選項是全額退款，不是折扣。
qs.trans: Northair 提供 NA 208 班機乘客什麼？

qs.q: Which appointment does Ms. Hart want to reschedule?
o: Her visit to the expo
Her meeting on October 14
Her meeting on October 12
Her flight on October 12
qs.h: 第三篇她想請誰改時間？再回第一篇查那個約會原本在哪一天。
qs.e: 第三篇她請 Ben 問 Fernwood Supplies 能否改在 10 月 13 日下午見面；第一篇顯示與 Fernwood Supplies 的會議原定 10 月 14 日上午，故選 (B)。
qs.w: (C) 10 月 12 日的會議是 Dalton Tech，她想準時參加；(A) 博覽會是主辦單位提早結束，不是她要改；(D) 改搭較早班機是「換班機」，題目問的是要改期的約會（appointment）。
qs.trans: Hart 女士想要更改哪一個約會的時間？

qs.q: If Fernwood Supplies agrees to her request, how many nights will Ms. Hart stay at the Kingsley Hotel?
o: One
Four
Three
Two
qs.h: 第一篇原本住幾晚？第三篇說如果對方同意，她要怎麼調整？
qs.e: 第一篇原定 10 月 12 日入住、15 日退房，共 3 晚；第三篇說如果 Fernwood 同意，她會在 14 日飛回並少住一晚，所以只住 12、13 日兩晚，故選 (D)。
qs.w: (A) 少了兩晚，與「少住一晚」不符；(C) 三晚是原定的住宿；(B) 文中沒有這種安排。
qs.trans: 如果 Fernwood Supplies 同意她的請求，Hart 女士會在 Kingsley 飯店住幾晚？
